summary: Asked city staff to look at opportunities for retail stores to use curb areas during the day when patios are closed.
source_quote: I've also asked staff to look at opportunities for retail stores to set-up in curb areas when patios aren't open during the day.

summary: States that police roles have expanded beyond traditional expectations and that new models of community safety are needed.
source_quote: We often ask too much of our police - over time expanding their roles and responsibilities that go far beyond the traditional expectations of policing. This is a sentiment I've heard from all sides and perspectives on policing, and it highlights the need to bring forward new models of community safety.

summary: Supports a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls as a critical piece of policing reform.
source_quote: A pilot project was approved for a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls. This step is a critical piece of policing reform and moves us towards ensuring that folks in crisis are receiving the help they need.

summary: States that a pilot is a valuable tool for evaluating new approaches with new partners before broader rollout.
source_quote: Setting out with a Pilot is a valuable tool when looking at something new, when we need to work with new partners, when we need to evaluate and make changes and improvements as we go.

pledge_text: Continue work to build out the non-police crisis response model and deliver outcomes across Toronto's communities.
specifics: Implementation of approved pilot for non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls.
source_quote: With this vote of approval from Council, the work now continues to make sure we build this right out and to deliver the outcomes we want to achieve across Toronto's communities.

summary: City Council approved a pilot project for a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls.
source_quote: At City Council this week we moved forward on a new framework to provide critical support and community based response for those experiencing crisis. A pilot project was approved for a non-police led response to non-violent crisis calls.

summary: States that projects like the Lakeshore Rail expansion need to be held to the highest environmental standards.
source_quote: Projects like the Lakeshore Rail expansion need to be held to the highest environmental standards.

summary: Supports protecting public spaces and keeping them green.
source_quote: An incredibly engaged community showed up last night to protect our public spaces and keep them green.

summary: States that streets are the city's largest network of public space and become more vibrant when made safe for people.
source_quote: Our streets are our largest network of public space. When we make them safe for people, we make them more vibrant.

summary: Supports projects like Yonge TOmorrow and Destination Danforth as building a 21st century city for people that supports safety and local businesses.
source_quote: Projects like #YongeTOmorrow and #DestinationDanforth build a 21st century city for people, creating an environment that supports safety and local businesses.

summary: Hosted a budget consultation for the East End community.
source_quote: Thank you to everyone that joined us for our #EastEnd budget consultation! This is an incredibly engaged community, and it showed last night with the fantastic turnout and thoughtful questions.

event_label: East End budget consultation
source_quote: Thank you to everyone that joined us for our #EastEnd budget consultation!

summary: States the community has had critical conversations on anti-Black racism and encourages participation in dialogue during Black History Month.
source_quote: We've had many critical conversations on anti-Black racism this year. This #BlackHistoryMonth, I'd encourage all of our community to find ways to participate in the dialogue.

pledge_text: Offers to bring constituents' ideas on ending systemic racism to City Hall.
source_quote: If you have ideas on what more we can be doing to end systemic racism, please reach out to me and I can bring your voice to City Hall.
specifics: Contact via Councillor_Bradford@toronto.ca

event_label: Toronto 2021 Budget Town Hall (Zoom)
topic_focus: 2021 City Budget — transit, affordable housing, small business support
source_quote: Coming up tonight! Join us for a conversation on the Toronto #2021Budget and ask your questions about the critical investments we’re making in transit, affordable housing, small business support, and much more.

summary: Spoke by phone with Fire Chief Jim Jessop about the Gainsborough fire.
source_quote: I just got off the phone to Fire Chief Jim Jessop about the devastating Gainsborough fire this morning.

summary: Characterizes the Gainsborough fire as one of Toronto's worst in recent decades and thanks fire crews.
source_quote: This is one of our city's worst fires in recent decades. Our community grieves together, and thanks the heroic crews who put themselves in harm's way to protect us

summary: States CaféTO was a success, with nearly 70% of surveyed local business owners saying they wouldn't have survived without it.
source_quote: The #CafeTO program was an incredible success - nearly 70% of our local business owners surveyed wouldn't have survived without it.

summary: States small businesses and main streets need support now more than ever.
source_quote: Our small businesses and main streets need our support now more than ever.

pledge_text: Bring back the CaféTO program in 2021 with improvements.
specifics: Earlier start (patios as early as May, public health permitting); easier registration; comprehensive traffic management plan; quick installations after approval.
source_quote: we’re bringing the program back with some improvements for 2021! ◽️We’ll be starting the program earlier, with patios opening as early as May (and as public health guidelines allow) ◽️Making the registration process easier and more accessible for businesses ◽️Creating a comprehensive traffic management plan to keep everyone safe on our streets ◽️Supporting quick installations, helping businesses ASAP after they’re approved for the program

summary: States that protecting the ecology and biodiversity of Small's Creek is critical and that transit expansion projects must meet the highest environmental standards.
source_quote: Protecting the ecology and biodiversity of Small's Creek is critical. As transit expansion continues, projects need to be held to the highest environmental standards to keep our public spaces green

summary: States that live music venues in Toronto have been at risk for years due to macroeconomic factors, with the pandemic worsening these challenges.
source_quote: For years, macro economic factors have put live music venues in Toronto at risk - but the pandemic has exacerbated those challenges.

summary: States that policy responses including affordable insurance for live music, tailored tax classes, identification of musical cultural heritage, and city programs for emerging talent must be explored to support Toronto's music ecosystem.
source_quote: Affordable insurance policies for live music, refined and tailored tax classes, identification of musical cultural heritage, city programs to help encourage emerging talent, and other policy responses must be explored to create sustainability and growth in Toronto's music ecosystem.

summary: States that surviving the pandemic is not enough; the recovery must allow the music industry to thrive.
source_quote: It will not be enough to just survive the pandemic - we need to ensure the road to recovery will allow the music industry to thrive.

quote_text: A city without music is a city without a soul.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States the 2021 budget focuses on collective recovery and building a stronger, more equitable city.
source_quote: First day of public consultations on the #2021Budget is underway! We're focused on our collective recovery - building a stronger and more equitable city.

summary: States that despite financial challenges, services were maintained and investments made in surface transit, community safety, and small business support.
source_quote: After a year of unprecedented financial challenges, we've worked to maintain services while making critical investments into surface transit, community safety, small business support, and much more.

summary: Investments made in the 2021 budget into surface transit, community safety, and small business support while maintaining services.
source_quote: we've worked to maintain services while making critical investments into surface transit, community safety, small business support, and much more.

event_label: First day of public consultations on the 2021 Budget
source_quote: First day of public consultations on the #2021Budget is underway!

summary: States Toronto needs more housing stock and choice beyond million-dollar homes and small starter condos to remain a place of growth and opportunity.
source_quote: If we want Toronto to continue being a place of growth and opportunity, we have to introduce more housing stock and more housing choice. At the moment, we just don't have many options outside of the million-dollar home or the small starter condo.

summary: Supports introducing 'Missing Middle' housing types — duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments — to address affordability and supply.
source_quote: The pilot will introduce Missing Middle types of housing, including duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments, while addressing the affordability and supply issues in Toronto's housing market.

pledge_text: Will look for a site and the right partners this Spring for a Missing Middle housing pilot project.
specifics: Spring 2021; pilot to include duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments.
source_quote: This Spring we'll be looking for a site and the right partners for this project. The pilot will introduce Missing Middle types of housing, including duplexes, triplexes, and four-storey apartments

summary: States the Missing Middle is crucial to addressing Toronto's housing affordability and supply problems.
source_quote: The Missing Middle is a crucial piece of addressing the problems with housing affordability and supply in Toronto.

summary: States Toronto needs housing options beyond multi-million dollar homes or starter condos to continue being a city of growth and opportunity.
source_quote: If we want Toronto to continue being a city of growth and opportunity, we need options other than multi-million $ homes or starter condos.

summary: Describes a Missing Middle Pilot aimed at building housing in that typology with affordability and sustainability elements, and identifying execution issues to inform replicable policy corrections.
source_quote: This Pilot is about accomplishing two key tasks. One, building housing that meets the Missing Middle typology while incorporating the affordability and sustainability elements Toronto needs. Two, to identify the execution issues so we can bring forward the policy corrections that'll make what we achieve in the Pilot build replicable across the city.

pledge_text: Will bring forward policy corrections identified through the Missing Middle Pilot to make the build replicable across the city.
specifics: Policy corrections derived from execution issues identified during the Pilot; goal is city-wide replicability.
source_quote: to identify the execution issues so we can bring forward the policy corrections that'll make what we achieve in the Pilot build replicable across the city.

summary: States Toronto needs more 'Missing Middle' housing options between single-family homes and high-rise condos, including duplexes, triplexes, and low-rise apartments.
source_quote: The Missing Middle is about bringing in options "in-between" the multi-million dollar house or high-rise condo. Missing Middle can refer to the need for middle of the road affordability and to the physical forms (like duplexes, triplexes, and low rise apartments) we need more of.

summary: States Toronto's housing crisis has persisted through the pandemic and more housing options are needed to build a city of opportunity.
source_quote: While the pandemic has shifted how and where we live, Toronto's housing crisis has remained all too constant. If we want to build back a Toronto of opportunity, we need to introduce more housing options

pledge_text: Will be on the ground during the Missing Middle pilot to identify process issues and bring forward policy corrections to make Missing Middle housing more possible across Toronto.
specifics: Use pilot learnings to propose city-wide policy corrections for Missing Middle housing.
source_quote: As we set out on the work, we'll be there on-the ground to understand the process issues so we can bring forward the policy corrections to make Missing Middle more possible across the city.

summary: Planning and Housing Committee voted in favour of Bradford's Missing Middle Housing Pilot for Beaches-East York.
source_quote: Today, the Planning and Housing Committee voted in favour of my Missing Middle Housing Pilot to Beaches-East York.

summary: States Toronto will be ready to administer vaccines as supply becomes available, in order to save lives and return to normal.
source_quote: As vaccine supply becomes more readily accessible, Toronto will be ready to get shots into arms, save lives, and start getting back to normal.

summary: Joined the Toronto Board of Health during the City's COVID-19 vaccination campaign.
source_quote: Honoured to join the Board of Health at such a critical time, as we discuss the @cityofto vaccination campaign.

event_label: Toronto Board of Health meeting on City vaccination campaign
source_quote: Honoured to join the Board of Health at such a critical time, as we discuss the @cityofto vaccination campaign.

summary: States that allowing essential businesses to sell non-essential items encourages non-essential trips and disadvantages small businesses.
source_quote: Currently, essential businesses can continue to sell non-essential items, encouraging non-essential trips and putting small businesses at a disadvantage.

summary: Calls on the Province to fix the rule allowing essential businesses to sell non-essential items, in support of small businesses.
source_quote: I'm joining the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas in calling on the Province to fix this and support our mom-and-pops.

summary: Joined the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas in calling on the Province to restrict essential businesses from selling non-essential items.
source_quote: I'm joining the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas in calling on the Province to fix this and support our mom-and-pops.

summary: States Toronto's housing crisis has remained constant through the pandemic.
source_quote: While the pandemic has shifted how and where we live, TO's housing crisis has remained all too constant.

summary: Supports launching a Missing Middle housing pilot in Beaches-East York.
source_quote: TO's Planning & Housing Committee will be discussing the launch of an important #housing pilot in Beaches-East York. Your voice is going to be crucial in moving this work out of the report and into the community.

summary: States small businesses have shouldered a disproportionate burden during the pandemic and need support.
source_quote: Small businesses have shouldered a disproportionate burden throughout the pandemic and this support will help see them through this second wave.

summary: Encourages residents to support local small businesses during lockdown.
source_quote: As we continue through this lockdown, support local whenever you can! Our mom-and-pops add so much to our communities and our main streets, and they need our support now more than ever.

summary: Promoted the opening of applications for the Ontario Small Business Support Grant.
source_quote: applications are open for the #Ontario Small Business Support Grant!

summary: States the 2021 Budget maintains critical services while setting a path for rebuilding, with equity-focused investments in pandemic response, community safety, and transit.
source_quote: This budget makes crucial, equity-focused investments in three key areas: pandemic response, community safety, and active and public transit.

summary: Supports allocating funds to establish community-driven alternative safety responses and anti-violence programs.
source_quote: We're allocating funds to establish and build out community driven alternative safety responses and anti-violence programs.

summary: Supports funding the TTC and restoring bus service to pre-pandemic levels, alongside renewed ActiveTO support.
source_quote: We're funding our transit system and marking dollars for buses (the workhorse of this pandemic) to restore service to overall pre-pandemic levels.

summary: Supports continued funding for CurbTO and CafeTO to support small businesses and Main Streets, with a spring relaunch.
source_quote: Supporting small business and our Main Streets - the lifelines of our neighbourhoods - will continue through funding CurbTO and CafeTO for a relaunch in the spring.

summary: States the City is keeping budgets flat while directing dollars into recovery, and calls on government partners for ongoing investments.
source_quote: The City is doing the work to keep budgets flat while driving dollars into support and recovery for the future ahead. Now we need our government partners to make the ongoing investments critical to keep the region's economic engine moving forward.

summary: Launched the 2021 City of Toronto Budget, maintaining services and investing in pandemic response, community safety, and transit.
source_quote: As we launch the 2021 Budget today, we're solidifying these efforts by maintaining the critical services that keep this City moving while setting a path for the rebuilding ahead.

summary: References City response programs launched during the pandemic: ActiveTO, Quiet Streets, and Digital Main Streets.
source_quote: we've responded with new and innovative programs like ActiveTO, Quiet Streets, Digital Main Streets, while making critical advancements to provide more child care, affordable housing, and transit improvements.

summary: States that entering a state of emergency is a difficult development and there will eventually be a review of how the crisis was handled.
source_quote: Going into a state of emergency is a tough blow. There will be a time of reckoning on how we handled this crisis. Right now we have to stay focused on ending this together.

summary: States that supporting small businesses (mom-and-pop shops) is among his current priorities during the emergency.
source_quote: among many priorities I'm focused on small business... an update on my work with our mom-and-pop shops

summary: States the goal of the proposed Woodbine Bike Lane changes is to prioritize road safety by maintaining bike lanes while improving traffic flow and addressing cut-through traffic on neighbouring streets.
source_quote: The goal for the proposed changes is to prioritize road safety by maintaining the bike lanes and finding every possible way to improve traffic flow to address concerns about congestion and related cut-through traffic on neighbouring streets.

event_label: Woodbine Bike Lanes Community Consultation (Zoom)
topic_focus: Proposed updates to the Woodbine Bike Lanes between Kingston Road and Gerrard East
source_quote: Join us on Zoom at 6pm on Monday, Jan 18th, to learn more about the proposal and have your voice heard.

summary: States that all levels of government need to work together for a quick and efficient vaccine rollout to vulnerable populations.
source_quote: Each level of government needs to be working together to get vaccines out of the freezers and into the arms of our most vulnerable.

summary: Urges community to stay focused on safety measures until more people can be vaccinated.
source_quote: We will get through this, but must stay focused on keeping ourselves and our communities safe until more folks are able to get their shot.

summary: Praises Michael Garron Hospital for its role during the pandemic.
source_quote: Yet another example of @michaelgarronhospital leading the way throughout the pandemic and keeping our community safe.

event_label: Online conversation with Councillor Paula Fletcher and Mayor John Tory on what's coming to East York and Toronto in 2021
source_quote: Join me this Sunday at 12pm for a conversation with Councillor @paulafletcher and Mayor @johntory on what's coming to East York and Toronto in 2021!

summary: States that continued focus and intergovernmental cooperation are needed during vaccine rollout.
source_quote: This is a moment of hope - but we can't lose focus. There is lots of work in the months ahead, and we need all levels of government working together.

event_label: Vaccination milestone at St. Clair O'Connor Community
topic_focus: COVID-19 vaccine rollout in long-term care homes
source_quote: Incredible moment at the St. Clair O'Connor Community today. With the needles in John and Beverley's arm, every resident in the 22 LTC homes in the @michaelgarronhospital network has been vaccinated!

summary: States that work moved forward on Destination Danforth in 2020.
source_quote: We moved forward with #destinationdanforth

summary: References transit upgrades including RapidTO bus priority lanes during 2020.
source_quote: transit upgrades like the RapidTO bus priority lanes

summary: References ActiveTO creating space for safe outdoor exercise during 2020.
source_quote: created space for folks to safely exercise with ActiveTO

summary: Invites constituents to share their priorities for Beaches-East York and Toronto for 2021.
source_quote: As we head into 2021 looking to make it a better year, what are your priorities for Beaches-East York and Toronto?

summary: States that 2020 was a historic year for road safety advocacy and cycling infrastructure expansion in Toronto.
source_quote: 2020 marked historic wins for road safety advocacy and cycling infrastructure expansion.

summary: Notes Toronto moved forward with 45 km of cycling network expansion in 2020, more than 5x previous years.
source_quote: In 2020, Toronto moved forward with 45 km of network expansion, more than 5x the amount achieved in previous years.

summary: Supports making programs like ActiveTO permanent.
source_quote: to ensure programs like ActiveTO become permanent 💪

summary: States that protecting the ecological integrity of Small's Creek ravine is of paramount importance.
source_quote: Protecting the ecological integrity of #smallscreek is of paramount importance.

summary: States that information sharing alone is not enough; calls for transparency, collaboration, and communication from Metrolinx.
source_quote: community members organized a site visit with @metrolinx to reiterate the need for transparency, collaboration, and communication. Information sharing is not enough

event_label: Small's Creek site visit with Metrolinx
source_quote: On December 18, community members organized a site visit with @metrolinx to reiterate the need for transparency, collaboration, and communication.

summary: States that food banks make a significant difference in local communities by helping those experiencing hunger.
source_quote: Food banks make a huge difference in our local communities by helping those in hunger.

summary: States that focus needs to remain on prevention as the community begins to round the corner on COVID-19.
source_quote: We are beginning to round the corner - but focus needs to remain on prevention. Stay safe this holiday season

event_label: First East End LTC worker vaccinations at Michael Garron Hospital
location: Michael Garron Hospital, Toronto East Health Network
source_quote: Incredible moment in our community as the first East End LTC workers were vaccinated this afternoon @michaelgarronhospital
topic_focus: COVID-19 vaccination rollout for long-term care workers

summary: States that small businesses have been under significant pressure during the second lockdown and encourages residents to support local Queen Street retailers.
source_quote: Our small businesses have been under significant pressure through this second lockdown. This holiday season, many #BEY businesses are offering great deals and discounts to encourage folks to #supportlocal.

summary: States the TTC weathered the pandemic ridership drop without major service cuts and without raising fares for 2021.
source_quote: We've weathered that storm without resorting to major service cuts and, as announced earlier this week, without raising fares for 2021.

summary: States surface transit will be vital to supporting local communities and transit system recovery.
source_quote: Ridership data continues to show us how vital surface transit will be to supporting our local communities and our transit system through recovery.

summary: Supports RapidTO Bus Priority Lanes as improving the network and saving time for essential workers.
source_quote: Initiatives like the RapidTO Bus Priority Lanes help improve our network and give valuable minutes back each day to countless essential workers.

summary: States public consultation is critical and that under-represented and under-consulted communities need to be engaged.
source_quote: We need to engage with the under-represented and under-consulted communities to ensure that we're getting things right.

summary: TTC froze fares for 2021 and avoided major service cuts during the pandemic.
source_quote: as announced earlier this week, without raising fares for 2021

summary: Supports freezing TTC fares for 2021 to keep transit affordable and help restore ridership.
source_quote: Freezing fares for 2021 is the right move to keep the #TTC affordable for folks and help to bring ridership back.

summary: States cooperation across levels of government helped avoid significant TTC service cuts or fare increases.
source_quote: Great to see cooperation from all levels of government to avoid significant service cuts or fare increases after an incredibly difficult year.

summary: Supports the vacant home tax as a tool to improve housing affordability and availability in Toronto.
source_quote: Great news for housing opportunity in Toronto as City Council votes to advance a vacant home tax today.

summary: States that pressures on Toronto rental housing will re-emerge in coming months and years despite recent market shifts.
source_quote: The market may have shifted a few degrees over the past few months, but the fundamentals that have made Toronto an extremely attractive place to live, work and invest still remain - and those pressures on rental housing will re-emerge in the months and years ahead.

summary: States no single policy is a complete solution but Toronto must continue developing tools for affordability and accessibility.
source_quote: No one policy tool is the be-all, end-all solution, but it's important that Toronto keeps developing the tools we need to make Toronto a more accessible and affordable place to live.

summary: City Council voted to advance a vacant home tax in Toronto.
source_quote: City Council votes to advance a vacant home tax today

summary: States that addressing systemic racism within the TTC and City services requires consistent effort, strategic planning, and accountability over years.
source_quote: Consistent effort, strategic planning, and accountability will help us drive this critical issue forward. It will take years to undo the legacies of systemic racism and discrimination within our City services.

summary: States that communicating updates to customers and Torontonians will be key to continued dialog and real change as the TTC does anti-racism work.
source_quote: As the TTC conducts this work, communicating updates with our customers and Torontonians will be key to continued dialog and real change.

summary: At a TTC Board meeting, putting in place a 10 point plan and 5 year strategy to help address systemic racism.
source_quote: At today's Board meeting we are putting in place a 10 point plan and 5 year strategy to help address systemic racism.

summary: Asked the TTC to report back on any additional resources needed to implement measures addressing anti-Black racism and increasing inclusion.
source_quote: I've also asked the TTC to report back on any additional resources that will be needed to make sure we can implement these critical measures to address anti-Black racism and increase inclusion in the organization.

summary: Announces completion of Gledhill Park playground enhancements, including accessibility improvements.
source_quote: The Gledhill Park playground enhancements are complete!

event_label: Gledhill Park playground enhancements completion
source_quote: The Gledhill Park playground enhancements are complete!

summary: States that the environmental crisis is one of the greatest challenges facing the world and that a more sustainable economy should be built coming out of the pandemic.
source_quote: The environmental crisis is one of the greatest challenges facing our world and we need to build back a more sustainable economy coming out of the pandemic.

event_label: Conversation with the Holistic Sustainable Development Network
source_quote: Great conversation this afternoon with the Holistic Sustainable Development Network.

summary: States need to stay focused on prevention and protecting the health care system until a broader COVID-19 vaccine rollout is possible.
source_quote: We're rounding a corner, but need to stay focused on prevention and protecting our health care system until a more broad rollout is possible.

summary: States that a housing data strategy is critical for good policy implementation and strengthens the city's position when engaging other levels of government on funding.
source_quote: Another important step from PHC today on developing a housing data strategy. Critical for good implementation as the numbers will show us where policies will have the most impact. Also strengthen our position when we're engaging with other levels of government on funding.

summary: Notes a step taken at the Planning and Housing Committee (PHC) on developing a housing data strategy.
source_quote: Another important step from PHC today on developing a housing data strategy.

summary: States that increasing housing options, including garden suites, is crucial for families caring for aging loved ones and people starting out in the city.
source_quote: From families looking to care for loved ones as they age-in-place to folks just starting out in the City - increasing housing options is crucial.

summary: Supports moving ahead on Garden Suites as a new housing option for Toronto.
source_quote: Great to see Committee vote to move ahead on a new housing option for the city: Garden Suites.

summary: Moved a motion at Planning and Housing Committee to grandfather in existing unique dwellings (coach houses, granny flats, garden suites) as part of consultations and by-law updates.
source_quote: as we set out on consultations and by-law updates, I moved a motion to make sure we include a way to "grandfather in" the many unique dwellings that are already providing housing here in Toronto.

summary: Supports exploring new ways to allow Garden Suites across Toronto as a new housing option.
source_quote: The City is exploring new ways to allow Garden Suites across Toronto. Tomorrow is an important day - Planning and Housing Committee will vote on whether to move ahead on new housing options for the city.

summary: Encourages residents to submit comments to the Planning and Housing Committee on the Garden Suites proposal.
source_quote: Your input is crucial! Check the link in my bio for more info on how you can submit comments to the committee!

summary: States a vacant home tax is less about revenue and more about smart policy to curb housing speculation.
source_quote: introducing a  policy like this is less about generating revenue and more about smart policy to curb housing speculation.

summary: States that with 1% rental vacancy and high demand, returning vacant homes to the market contributes to affordability.
source_quote: With 1% rental vacancy & insatiable demand, every home back on the market contributes to affordability.

summary: States a well-designed vacant home tax can accommodate legitimate reasons a home might be vacant.
source_quote: A well-designed policy can address concerns where a home might be vacant for legitimate reasons.

summary: Notes Toronto can learn from Vancouver's experience with vacant home tax policies.
source_quote: Policies like this have been around for a few years in places like Vancouver, and we have an opportunity to learn and improve on their experience.

summary: States that distributed energy is a way to tackle the climate crisis.
source_quote: Spoke to the Association of Power Producers Of Ontario about the ways we the can tackle our climate crisis through distributed energy.

summary: Spoke to the Association of Power Producers of Ontario about tackling the climate crisis through distributed energy.
source_quote: Spoke to the Association of Power Producers Of Ontario about the ways we the can tackle our climate crisis through distributed energy.

event_label: Address to the Association of Power Producers of Ontario
source_quote: Spoke to the Association of Power Producers Of Ontario about the ways we the can tackle our climate crisis through distributed energy.

summary: States Toronto has a winter recreation plan to keep residents physically and mentally healthy during COVID while staying safe.
source_quote: Did you know that Toronto has an incredible plan for making the most of this winter? A lot of winter rec programming starts today. With COVID affecting the season, we're finding ways to make the most of the cold and dark to keep ourselves physically and mentally healthy while staying safe.

summary: Announces City funding available for winter activations and lists winter amenities including toboggan hills, snow loops, outdoor rinks, disc golf, Walk Fit programs, and High Park car-free weekends.
source_quote: The City's also making funding available for winter activations so make sure to read on. ✅ 23 toboggan hills in neighbourhoods across Toronto ✅ 8 snow loops for walking and snowshoeing at the City's five golf courses

summary: Announces City will more than double its supply of winter park washrooms from 64 to 143 as part of COVID-19 response.
source_quote: The City will more than double its supply of winter park washrooms from 64 to 143 as part of its ongoing response to COVID-19

summary: Notes City is accepting applications until December 31 for community-built and maintained natural ice rinks in City parks.
source_quote: Up to 30-plus natural ice rinks – the City is accepting applications until December 31 for community-built and maintained natural ice rinks in City parks

summary: States there is an urgent need for affordable housing in Toronto.
source_quote: We have an urgent need for affordable housing in Toronto.

event_label: Community Consultation on 1631 Queen (Queen & Coxwell redevelopment)
location: Queen & Coxwell, Toronto (virtual registration via createto.ca/1631queen)
source_quote: The @cityofto is redeveloping public lands for housing and other neighbourhood investments. Come give your input at the early stages of a proposal near Queen & Coxwell. Dec 7th, 7pm.

summary: States the Province has the power to implement an eviction moratorium and calls on it to act.
source_quote: The Province is the level of government with the power to implement this. They have been vocal about being partners and can now make a real difference for communities in this city by taking this important step.

summary: Supports halting residential and commercial evictions during the COVID-19 lockdown.
source_quote: City Council voted unanimously for my motion to stop residential & commercial evictions during this lockdown.

summary: Brought a motion at City Council to stop residential and commercial evictions during the lockdown; passed unanimously.
source_quote: Earlier today, City Council voted unanimously for my motion to stop residential & commercial evictions during this lockdown.

summary: States residents should wear masks and maintain distance from those outside their household during the COVID-19 lockdown.
source_quote: Stay safe, wear a mask, and keep your distance from folks outside of your household.

summary: States that going into lockdown is a major blow but the only choice to fight COVID long-term.
source_quote: Going into lockdown is a major blow but it's our only choice to fight this long-term.

summary: Supports reinstating the moratorium on evictions for families and small businesses.
source_quote: starting with reinstating the moratorium on evictions for families & small businesses

summary: States the Province can stop evictions and help people pay the rent.
source_quote: The Province can stop evictions for families and businesses, and help people pay the rent

summary: Supports Feds and Province doubling down on funding for heavily impacted sectors, especially health, wellness and fitness studios.
source_quote: The Feds and Province can double down on funding commitments for sectors that have been most heavily impacted, especially health, wellness and fitness studios to help them keep the lights on.

summary: Supports accelerating rollout of rapid transit network including bus priority corridors at the City level.
source_quote: accelerating roll-out of our rapid transit network like bus priority corridors (City)

summary: Supports addressing systemic policy issues like commercial tax assessments at City and Province levels.
source_quote: addressing systemic policy issues like commercial tax assessments (City and Province)

summary: States Feds, Provinces and Cities need to align with funding committed from levels of government best able to pay.
source_quote: Feds, Provinces and Cities need to align, and have funding committed from the levels of government that have the best ability to pay.

summary: States that getting outdoors for fresh air and sunlight will be crucial for mental and physical health during winter.
source_quote: Getting outdoors for fresh air and some sunlight will be crucial for our mental and physical health this winter.

summary: Supports doubling winter washroom access in city parks to facilitate continued safe outdoor use.
source_quote: The City's responding to advocacy from across the city and planning to double winter washroom access: 79 facilities in 64 locations will help us stay safe and healthy.

summary: City announced plan to double winter washroom access to 79 facilities in 64 locations in response to advocacy.
source_quote: The City's responding to advocacy from across the city and planning to double winter washroom access: 79 facilities in 64 locations will help us stay safe and healthy.

summary: States electric vehicles will play a critical role in meeting Toronto's emission goals.
source_quote: Electric vehicles will play a critical role in meeting our emission goals across the City.

summary: States the biggest barrier to EV ownership is lack of access to convenient charging stations.
source_quote: Recent studies have shown that the biggest barrier to EV ownership is a lack of access to convenient charging stations.

summary: States front yard parking pads could allow residents to charge EVs in front of their home, subject to existing environmental regulations.
source_quote: Front yard parking, or parking pads, would provide a place for folks to charge their vehicle right in front of their home. There are strict environmental regulations in place for front yard parking, with requirements for permeable paving materials and protecting trees.

summary: States the front yard parking application process is broken and is frequently circumvented through appeal boards.
source_quote: Unfortunately, the process to apply for front yard parking is broken. People frequently skirt around the process through appeal boards in order to achieve their desired outcome.

summary: Calls for a pragmatic approach to incentivize EV use in neighbourhoods.
source_quote: We need a pragmatic approach to incentivize EV use in our neighbourhoods.

summary: Unveiled an EV Charging Station pilot with 17 charging stations around Toronto.
source_quote: Recently we unveiled the EV Charging Station pilot with 17 charging stations around Toronto.

summary: States need to work with federal and provincial partners to support small businesses and help municipalities recover.
source_quote: Need to work with our federal and provincial partners to support our small businesses, protect our communities, and come back stronger.

event_label: FCM Ontario Caucus meeting
topic_focus: Municipal recovery, small business support, intergovernmental cooperation
source_quote: Meeting with the @fcmgram Ontario Caucus to discuss the road to recovery for our municipalities.

summary: States that the 2019 Danforth pop-up by 8 80 Cities helped lay the foundation for the summer 2020 Danforth transformation.
source_quote: 8 80 and many others helped lay the foundation for Danforth with the 2019 pop-up, supported by a generous private donor.

summary: States Toronto has a housing crisis and that multi-tenant homes play a crucial role in providing affordable housing.
source_quote: It's no secret that we have a housing crisis in Toronto. Multi-tenant homes have long played a crucial role in providing an affordable place to live, and we need to legitimize them across the city.

summary: Supports legitimizing multi-tenant homes city-wide and creating pathways to compliance to support housing supply and safety.
source_quote: Creating pathways to compliance supports our housing supply and creates a safer environment for our neighbours in these homes.

summary: States the city should keep public infrastructure clean to encourage outdoor activity during winter amid the pandemic.
source_quote: We need to incentivize folks to avoid indoor gatherings and get outside this winter. Keeping our infrastructure clean is a great place to start!

summary: States that residents can request road safety measures through their local councillor and invites ideas to make Beaches-East York the safest area in the city.
source_quote: Did you know that you can request road safety measures by reaching out to your local councillor? Share your ideas and let's make Beaches-East York the safest area in the City!

summary: States Dr. de Villa's decision to bring in more COVID-19 restrictions in Toronto is difficult but correct.
source_quote: Dr. de Villa is making the extremely difficult, but correct, decision to bring in more restrictions in Toronto, starting Saturday.

summary: States urgent support is needed for businesses facing further pressure from closures during the pandemic.
source_quote: These closures put even further pressure on businesses that have been struggling throughout the pandemic and urgent support is needed.

summary: Supports creating new commercial tax bands so neighbourhood stores aren't taxed the same as office towers.
source_quote: We need new commercial tax bands to prevent neighbourhood stores being taxed the same as an office tower.

summary: Supports further protection for commercial tenants against unscrupulous landlords.
source_quote: We need further protection for commercial tenants to protect against unscrupulous landlords.

summary: Supports City incentives for entrepreneurs through lower start-up costs.
source_quote: There are also opportunities for the City to incentivize entrepreneurs with lower start-up costs.

summary: States economic recovery will run through main street and small businesses must be protected through another lockdown.
source_quote: Our economic recovery will run through main street and we need to do everything we can to protect our mom-and-pops through another lockdown.

quote_text: Our economic recovery will run through main street and we need to do everything we can to protect our mom-and-pops through another lockdown.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States Toronto is one of the most diverse cities in the world and the monument celebrates that diversity.
source_quote: We have one of the most diverse cities in the world, and this monument is a celebration of that diversity.

summary: Attended the groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument in Dentonia Park.
source_quote: This Saturday, we celebrated the groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument right here in Dentonia Park.

event_label: Groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument
source_quote: This Saturday, we celebrated the groundbreaking of the International Mother Language Monument right here in Dentonia Park.

summary: Announced an Electric Vehicle Charging pilot at Stephenson Park.
source_quote: Great morning at Stephenson Park announcing our Electric Vehicle Charging pilot!

event_label: Electric Vehicle Charging pilot announcement
source_quote: Great morning at Stephenson Park announcing our Electric Vehicle Charging pilot!

summary: States EVs will be important in meeting climate goals and convenient charging can incentivize adoption.
source_quote: We know how important EVs will be in meeting our climate goals, and introducing convenient charging options can help incentivize folks to make the switch.

summary: States Toronto needs to encourage residents to get out safely in winter, including by winterizing patios.
source_quote: This year in particular it's crucial that we encourage folks to get out in the city, safely. We need to embrace winter in a different way. Winterizing patios is one path we're moving forward on, but more is needed.

summary: Suggests winter park trails and indoor-outdoor spaces as ways to encourage people to get outside in winter.
source_quote: Winter parks trails and indoor-outdoor spaces are just some other examples how we can encourage folks to get out.

summary: States the city is moving forward on winterizing patios.
source_quote: Winterizing patios is one path we're moving forward on, but more is needed.

summary: States Winter Stations will help bring people out safely during a dark winter and draw visitors to the East End.
source_quote: This will be a particularly dark winter, and we need to do what we can to get folks out safely. @winter.stations will light up our community and bring visitors from across the City to see what the East End has to offer!

event_label: Winter Stations announcement / Global News interview with Susan Hay
source_quote: Great to chat with Susan Hay from @globalnewsto about what Winter Stations brings to the community!

summary: Notes the Cenotaph in Kew Gardens was recently updated to honour the 128 Canadians who lost their lives in Afghanistan peacekeeping efforts.
source_quote: the Cenotaph in Kew Gardens was updated recently to honour the 128 Canadians who lost their lives in Afghanistan peacekeeping efforts.

event_label: Virtual Remembrance Day ceremony live-stream
location: Kew Gardens / Beaches—East York (virtual via Instagram and Facebook)
topic_focus: Remembrance Day commemoration of Canadian veterans
source_quote: I’ll be live-streaming a Remembrance ceremony through Instagram and Facebook to honour those who made the ultimate sacrifice in defence of our freedoms. Join me at 11am next Wednesday, November 11th

pledge_text: Will live-stream a Remembrance Day ceremony on November 11th at 11am via Instagram and Facebook.
specifics: November 11th, 11am, via Instagram and Facebook
source_quote: I’ll be live-streaming a Remembrance ceremony through Instagram and Facebook to honour those who made the ultimate sacrifice in defence of our freedoms. Join me at 11am next Wednesday, November 11th

summary: States a community poll is required before introducing road safety measures on local streets.
source_quote: A community poll is required before introducing any road safety measures onto local streets.

summary: Designated November as Road Safety Month in Beaches-East York and launched an online tool to collect community poll support for road safety measures during the pandemic.
source_quote: We're making November #RoadSafetyMonth in Beaches-East York! ... so I've created an online tool to collect support and ensure our efforts to make streets safer don't fall behind.

summary: States environmental considerations such as permeable paving and tree protection must come first in front yard parking pad rules.
source_quote: nothing has changed in terms of the requirements to have permeable paving and to protect trees. The environmental considerations have to come first and foremost.

summary: Supports enabling EV ownership as a significant part of meeting Toronto's climate goals.
source_quote: We have a long way to go to meet our climate goals - enabling EV ownership will play a significant part.

summary: Supports opening up front yard parking pad application process to make more households eligible, framed as incentivizing EV ownership.
source_quote: This is a big step forward to incentivizing electric vehicle ownership to meet our climate goals.

summary: Council lifted the parking pad ban north of the Danforth and made changes to open up the application process for front yard parking.
source_quote: We’re inching forward on parking pads with good progress at Council yesterday! The ban north of the Danforth has been lifted and we’ve made a number of changes towards opening up the application process to make more households eligible for front yard parking.

summary: New EV charging stations installed in the neighbourhood — one at Bowmore/Eastwood, another opening on Westlake.
source_quote: we have some new EV chargers in the neighbourhood! One station is at Bowmore/Eastwood with another opening on Westlake next weekend.

summary: Brought forward a road map of recommendations to Council to boost small business, keep main streets thriving, and support local shops; Council unanimously approved it.
source_quote: Yesterday, Council unanimously approved my road map to boost small business, keep main streets thriving and support our mom and pops.

summary: States that the Toronto Office of Rebuild & Recovery report had 83 recommendations for a healthy physical, social, and economic recovery.
source_quote: The Toronto Office of Rebuild & Recovery report had 83 recommendations for a healthy physical, social, and economic recovery.

summary: States Toronto needs a new fiscal deal with senior levels of government, citing the TORR report.
source_quote: The TORR report lays clear the need for a new deal for Toronto.

summary: States municipal government most directly affects residents' day-to-day lives and resources/funding from government partners should reflect that.
source_quote: This is the level of government that most directly affects folks day-to-day lives. We need the resources and funding from our government partners to reflect this reality.

summary: States that high commissions (as much as 35%) charged by food delivery apps hurt local restaurants and Toronto should address this as LA, New York, and Seattle have.
source_quote: Some popular meal service apps charge restaurants commissions as high as 35%. With local businesses hurting so badly right now, we should be tackling this like LA, New York and Seattle have.

summary: Observes that restaurants, cafes, and bars have been struggling during the pandemic and that delivery app fees worsen their margins.
source_quote: Restaurants, cafes, and bars have been having a tough time throughout the pandemic... However, many of these apps have significant fees that restaurants must pay. This hurts their bottom line and makes the margins even more thin.

summary: States road safety is his top local priority.
source_quote: Road safety is my top local priority and throughout the pandemic I've been working with residents to introduce new traffic calming measures throughout the neighbourhood.

summary: Notes City by-laws require a polling process to introduce traffic calming measures on residential streets, and that COVID-19 has caused large backlogs.
source_quote: City by-laws require a polling process in order to introduce these measures on residential streets. With large backlogs due to the COVID-19 pandemic

summary: Working directly with community to run polls on road safety interventions to bypass City backlog and advance traffic calming measures.
source_quote: I'm working directly with the community to run polls on road safety interventions so that our efforts to make our streets safer don't fall behind.

summary: Posted a digital list of community polls on his website (bradbradford.ca/petitions) for residents to show support for traffic calming on their streets.
source_quote: On my website is a digital list of community polls which can be used to show support. Check out bradbradford.ca/petitions (link in bio) for more information and a list of active polls.

quote_text: Road safety is my top local priority.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: Started an online petition to rename a laneway south of Gerrard and east of Wayland after Reese Fallon, a victim of the 2018 Danforth shooting.
source_quote: Neighbour support is needed to officially rename a laneway in Toronto. I started an online petition to gather this support. Please visit my website at bradbradford.ca/reeselane (link in bio) for more information or to sign the petition.

summary: Supports naming a laneway after Reese Fallon, a victim of the 2018 Danforth shooting, at a location south of Gerrard and east of Wayland.
source_quote: We want to honour her short but impactful time with us by naming a laneway after her. The proposed location is south of Gerrard and east of Wayland. This location was chosen because of the proximity to her home, her schools, and her friends.

summary: States that procuring new subways, streetcars, and buses is as important as transit expansion for meeting service goals.
source_quote: Procuring these additional subways, streetcars, and buses are just as important as transit expansion in terms of meeting our service goals.

summary: States Toronto is contributing its fair share and calls on Provincial and Federal governments to match contributions for transit investment.
source_quote: The City is contributing our fair share to these investments. Toronto is the economic engine of Canada and we need the Provincial and Federal governments to step up, match our contributions, and build a 21st century system with us.

summary: Organized/participated in the Beach Pick-Me-Up community cleanup event with Tiffany Pratt at Woodbine Beach.
source_quote: we're throwing it back to the Beach Pick-Me-Up with @thetiffanypratt! It was an incredible turnout from the community and the commitment to keeping our shared spaces beautiful was fantastic.

event_label: Beach Pick-Me-Up
source_quote: we're throwing it back to the Beach Pick-Me-Up with @thetiffanypratt!

summary: States that restaurants and bars need innovative support during indoor dining shutdown.
source_quote: Running a restaurant or bar is tough at the best of times. Now with indoor dining shut down, we need to take innovative steps to support small businesses.

summary: Describes the CafeTO patio program as a success.
source_quote: The #CafeTO patios have been a huge success

pledge_text: Looking at extending CafeTO patios through the winter and into next spring and summer.
specifics: Extension of CafeTO patios through winter, spring, and summer
source_quote: we're looking at how we can extend them through the winter, into next spring and summer

event_label: Fairmount Park Bake Oven makeover
source_quote: The Fairmount Park Bake Oven got a makeover, courtesy of the community! Thanks to Barry Ross, Dieter Epp, John Corcoran, Scott Rogers, and Joseph Romain for putting their own time and resources in to make this community even more special!

summary: Canvassed for neighbour support to name a laneway in memory of Reese Fallon, a victim of the 2018 Danforth Shooting.
source_quote: Emotional afternoon canvassing for neighbour support to name a laneway in memory of Reese Fallon, one of the two victims whose life was tragically cut short in the Danforth Shooting on July 22, 2018.

pledge_text: Together with Reese Fallon's family, will work to name a laneway after her near her home, schools, and friends.
specifics: Proposed laneway location close to her home and the schools she attended; supporters can sign on at bradbradford.ca/reeselane
source_quote: With her family, we would like to name a Laneway after her. This would be a legacy to her short yet impactful time among us. The proposed location is close to her home, the schools that she attended and to the many friends who cherished her.

summary: States the hospitality industry has been uniquely and devastatingly impacted by the pandemic and relies heavily on face-to-face interactions.
source_quote: The unique and devastating impact on the hospitality industry throughout the pandemic does not need to be re-stated. It's a tough business that relies heavily on face-to-face interactions to stay profitable.

summary: States small businesses and the hospitality sector are a strength of Toronto.
source_quote: Our incredible small businesses and hospitality sector are a strength of Toronto, and we're looking forward to growing back even stronger.

summary: Served as Small Business lead on Mayor John Tory's Economic Support and Recovery Task Force, consulting weekly with business owners and advocating to provincial and federal partners.
source_quote: As the Small Business lead for Mayor @johntory's Economic Support and Recovery Task Force, I spoke with hundreds of business owners each week. This feedback and open dialogue shaped my advocacy to our provincial and federal partners and allowed for programs that would better support our small businesses.

summary: States that mopeds, electric scooters, and motorcycles must stay on the road, not in the cycle track, and only pedal-assisted e-bikes are permitted in the cycle track.
source_quote: Remember that e-bikes are only allowed if they are pedal assisted! Mopeds, electric scooters, and motorcycles need to stay on the road for everyone's safety.

summary: Joined 55 Division on Danforth and Woodbine during evening commute to educate cyclists on rules for the new cycle track.
source_quote: Out on Danforth and Woodbine for the evening commute with @55_division last night educating folks on what is and isn't allowed in the new cycle track.

event_label: Cycle track education ride-along with 55 Division
source_quote: Out on Danforth and Woodbine for the evening commute with @55_division last night educating folks on what is and isn't allowed in the new cycle track.

summary: States that procuring new TTC vehicles will ensure Toronto is prepared for transit demand in a post-pandemic world.
source_quote: Procuring new #TTC vehicles will ensure that we're prepared for demand in a post-pandemic world.

summary: States Toronto is the economic lifeblood of Canada and needs support from provincial and federal partners to reflect that.
source_quote: Toronto is the economic lifeblood of this country and we need support from our Provincial and Federal partners to reflect that.

summary: States the TTC will be crucial to Toronto's pandemic recovery and that planning for post-pandemic transit needs must begin now.
source_quote: Our transit network will be crucial to our recovery and we know that we need to start planning now for our post-pandemic needs.

summary: States that other levels of government should join the City in funding TTC vehicle acquisition.
source_quote: This is a significant investment from the City and we're looking for the other levels of government to join us.

summary: Joined Mayor John Tory to announce City investment in acquiring more TTC vehicles, including 80 subway trains, 13 streetcars, 300 hybrid buses, 300 e-buses, and 70 Wheel-Trans buses.
source_quote: I joined Mayor @johntory this morning to announce a significant investment into acquiring more #TTC vehicles to meet rising demand.

event_label: TTC vehicle investment announcement with Mayor John Tory
source_quote: I joined Mayor @johntory this morning to announce a significant investment into acquiring more #TTC vehicles to meet rising demand.

quote_text: Keeping the #TTC moving will help to ensure that the economic engine of Canada is running smoothly.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: Encourages safe travel on the new Danforth complete street when heading to work or supporting local businesses.
source_quote: When you're heading out to work or to support local businesses on #DestinationDanforth, travel safely! Check out these quick tips to protect yourself and others on the new complete street.

summary: States the city needs smart, practical solutions to support the transition to electric vehicles in neighbourhoods.
source_quote: We need smart, practical solutions to support the transition towards electric vehicles in our neighbourhoods.

summary: Supports modernizing local infrastructure ('bringing our infrastructure into the 21st century').
source_quote: bringing our infrastructure into the 21st century!

event_label: Meeting with neighbours on Fernwood Park Avenue
topic_focus: road safety, EV transition, and infrastructure
source_quote: Great meeting with neighbours on Fernwood Park Avenue to discuss road safety and bringing our infrastructure into the 21st century!

summary: States that residents need to be able to use local beaches safely.
source_quote: Our community is home to some of the most beautiful beaches in Canada and we need to ensure that folks are able to use them safely.

summary: Met with City staff to discuss steps to improve safety on the waterfront.
source_quote: I met with staff last week to determine what steps we can take to improve safety on the waterfront!

event_label: Visit to Woodbine Beach
source_quote: Our community is home to some of the most beautiful beaches in Canada

summary: States commitment to ongoing work to address systemic racism and create a more equal society.
source_quote: We know that there is much more work to be done to truly make our society equal, but we are fully committed to that work.

summary: Hosted a virtual community meeting covering topics including community safety during the pandemic and systemic racism.
source_quote: Thank you to everyone from the community who joined our virtual community meeting last night! ... We covered a wide variety of topics, from general community safety during the pandemic to addressing systemic racism.

event_label: Virtual Community Meeting
topic_focus: community safety during the pandemic and systemic racism
source_quote: Thank you to everyone from the community who joined our virtual community meeting last night!

summary: States surface transit has played an important role during the pandemic, moving essential workers across the city.
source_quote: Surface transit has played an incredibly important role throughout the pandemic. Our buses and streetcars have moved thousands of essential workers across the city every day, keeping it functioning over the past several months.

summary: Supports priority bus routes, stating they will produce more frequent service, less crowding, and more efficient commutes.
source_quote: Priority bus routes will result in more frequent service and less crowding as well as more efficient commutes for all users.

summary: States priority bus routes are a step toward supporting Toronto suburbs historically underserved by transit but reliant on it.
source_quote: This is a huge step towards supporting the Toronto suburbs that have been historically underserved by transit but heavily rely on it to get around.

summary: States that community safety is top of mind for residents with fall and back to school underway.
source_quote: With fall upon us and back to school well underway, a lot of us are thinking about safety in the community.

summary: Acknowledges community conversations about racism experienced by Black, Indigenous and People of Colour residents.
source_quote: the difficult but important conversations we have been having as a community around racism experienced by Black, Indigenous and People of Colour (BIPOC) residents

event_label: Community Safety Town Hall (virtual)
source_quote: I would like to invite you to a community safety town hall with me and Superintendent Reuben Stroble from Toronto Police Services, 55 Division. The meeting will be held virtually on Wednesday, October 7th from 6:30 pm to 8:30 pm.

summary: Supports ranked ballot voting as a step toward a more representative democracy in Toronto.
source_quote: Ranked ballot voting is an important step towards a democracy that is more representative of our diversity.

summary: States the current voting status quo is not working for thousands of Torontonians and rejects 'if it ain't broke, don't fix it' framing.
source_quote: "If it ain't broke, don't fix it" is an acceptance of the status quo that is not working for thousands of Torontonians.

summary: Observes that cities across the globe are adopting ranked ballot voting and benefiting, and Toronto should join them.
source_quote: Cities across the globe are adopting this system and reaping the benefits that come with it. We should join them and take the steps towards a more representative democracy.

summary: Supports protecting small businesses from evictions and reducing pressures from rising insurance costs as part of COVID response.
source_quote: protecting mom and pops from evictions, and reducing the pressures of rising insurance costs

summary: Contributed recommendations via Mayor Tory's COVID task force that were included in the Mayor's five-point plan to support local businesses.
source_quote: Mayor Tory's five-point plan to support local businesses as cases rise, including my recommendations from his COVID task force on protecting mom and pops from evictions, and reducing the pressures of rising insurance costs.

summary: States municipalities do much of the heavy lifting on building housing but have the fewest tools to support it.
source_quote: Municipalities do much of the heavy lifting in building housing but have the fewest tools to support this.

summary: Calls for a new deal for Canadian municipalities with Provincial and Federal governments contributing their fair share toward housing.
source_quote: We need a new deal for Canadian municipalities that sees the Provincial and Federal government contribute their fair share towards housing residents.

summary: ActiveTO program extended through October, providing space for active transportation during the pandemic.
source_quote: A huge win for active transportation with the #ActiveTO program being extended through October!

summary: Supports ActiveTO, stating it has been a success and provides safe space for fresh air and exercise during the second wave.
source_quote: It's been a huge success and continuing to provide a safe space for folks to get fresh air and exercise as we enter the second wave is crucial.

summary: States the ActiveTO program has been a success and that providing safe space for outdoor exercise during the second wave of COVID-19 is crucial.
source_quote: A huge win for active transportation with the #ActiveTO program being extended into October! It's been a huge success and continuing to provide a safe space for folks to get fresh air and exercise as we enter the second wave is crucial.

summary: States urgent action is needed to protect the climate and calls for further investments and commitment from all levels of government toward a sustainable society.
source_quote: Urgent action is needed to protect our climate and ensure we leave a livable world for generations to come. We need further investments into creating a truly sustainable society and commitment from all levels of government to make a change.

summary: States that Above Guideline Rent Increases threaten housing affordability for many Toronto residents.
source_quote: Above Guideline Rent Increases (AGIs) threaten to make that unaffordable for many.

summary: Supports asking the Province to close the AGI loophole, in keeping with the spirit of the 2021 rent freeze.
source_quote: In keeping with the spirit of the 2021 rent freeze, we’re asking the Province to close the AGI loophole.

summary: Asked the Province to close the Above Guideline Rent Increase (AGI) loophole.
source_quote: we’re asking the Province to close the AGI loophole

summary: Condemns the discovery of nooses at Michael Garron Hospital construction site as anti-Black racism with no place in the East End.
source_quote: I am disgusted by the recent discovery of two more nooses on a construction site @michaelgarronhospital. This is a disgusting display of Anti-Black racism and has no place in the East End.

summary: States that Toronto's diversity makes the city an incredible place and that work remains to ensure no one experiences racism.
source_quote: Our diversity is one of the many things that make this city an incredible place to live. Blatant hatred like this is a stark reminder that we have much work to do to ensuring that no one has to experience racism in our city.

quote_text: The East End stands with the victims of these horrific incidents.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States the PRESTO system rollout was flawed but the city needs to move forward and implement changes.
source_quote: The rollout of the PRESTO system was not perfect... While the rollout was flawed, we need to move forward and implement the changes that will keep our transit system world class.

summary: Supports modernizing the fare system to allow open payments and account-based technology.
source_quote: 💳 Modernize the system to allow open payments and account-based technology

summary: Supports giving the TTC a role in selecting providers of the back-end technology to improve user experience.
source_quote: 🧰 The TTC will have a role in selecting providers of the back-end technology, improving user experience

summary: TTC negotiated a new agreement with Metrolinx giving the TTC more input into PRESTO implementation, coming to the TTC Board.
source_quote: The #TTC have been working out a new agreement with @metrolinx that will give us more input to the process, coming to the Board on Thursday.

summary: States the pandemic has highlighted cracks in the housing system and that these committee steps are crucial to recovery.
source_quote: The pandemic has highlighted the cracks in our housing system and these steps are crucial as we look towards our recovery.

summary: Planning and Housing Committee advanced an implementation plan for the 10-year housing strategy.
source_quote: Implementation plan for our 10 year #housing strategy

summary: Planning and Housing Committee advanced a new income-based definition for affordable housing.
source_quote: New income-based definition for affordable housing

summary: Planning and Housing Committee advanced the next step to require affordable housing in new developments.
source_quote: Next step to require affordable housing in new developments

summary: Promotes Cycle Toronto's Ride for Safe Streets to raise awareness for road safety.
source_quote: The #RideForSafeStreets with @cycletoronto is on now! Head online to register yourself or your social bubble, choose your route, and help raise awareness for road safety.

event_label: Ride for Safe Streets (Cycle Toronto)
source_quote: The #RideForSafeStreets with @cycletoronto is on now!

summary: Bringing measures to council including accessible loading zones on Kingston and Main, parking amendments on Kingston/Vent or/Rumney, compulsory stop controls on Keystone and Cedarvale, and realigning permit parking north of the Danforth.
source_quote: Here are the measures I'm bringing to council today: Adding accessible loading zones on Kingston and Main; Parking amendments on Kingston, Vent or, and Rumney; Compulsory stop controls on Keystone and Cedarvale; Realigning permit parking north of the Danforth

pledge_text: More road safety measures to come following the current package brought to council.
source_quote: Important steps to protecting all road users, with more coming soon!

summary: States road safety is top of mind as people return to work and school, and that active transportation users must be protected however they choose to get around.
source_quote: As folks go back to work and kids are heading back to school, road safety is top of mind. Active transportation is being rediscovered by many and it's crucial that they're protected, however they choose to get around.

summary: States intergovernmental partnerships with federal and provincial governments are necessary for an equitable solution to the housing crisis.
source_quote: Intergovernmental partnerships are critical to relieving pressure on our housing and shelter system. Support from federal (@justinpjtrudeau @chrystiafreeland @ahmeddhussen @cmhc_prez) and provincial (@fordnationdougford @steveclarkmpp) partners will be necessary for an equitable solution to the housing crisis.

summary: States the COVID-19 pandemic shows the need to accelerate the HousingTO 10-year action plan and shift toward permanent solutions to homelessness rather than reactive emergency measures.
source_quote: The COVID-19 pandemic has shown that we need to accelerate the actions of the HousingTO 10-year action plan. These 3,000 units will not only help us recover safely, but show the change towards permanent, sustainable solutions to homelessness rather than reactive, emergency measures.

summary: Announces the City's COVID-19 Housing and Homeless Recovery Plan to fast-track 3,000 permanent, affordable homes in 24 months.
source_quote: The City just released it's COVID-19 Housing and Homeless Recovery Plan to fast-track 3,000 permanent, affordable homes in 24 months.

summary: States that proactive, creative responses supporting small businesses are what communities expect from local government during the pandemic.
source_quote: This is the kind of proactive, creative response communities expect from their local government, especially at a time like this.

summary: Expanded patio heater permissions citywide, creating simplified rules to extend patio season and support restaurants during the pandemic.
source_quote: we've expanded patio heater permissions for patios across the city. The new permissions create a set of simplified rules that maintain safety and help extend patio season to support business.

summary: Worked with the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas and Mayor John Tory, gathering feedback from hundreds of small businesses during the pandemic.
source_quote: Working closely with the Toronto Association of Business Improvement Areas and Mayor @johntory - I've been listening to feedback from hundreds of small businesses to get through the pandemic.

summary: States that 'missing middle' housing is a crucial planning tool to expand housing options and improve affordability in Toronto.
source_quote: It's a crucial planning tool that will allow for more housing options in our communities and improve affordability for Torontonians.

summary: States that thoughtful policy changes like missing middle housing are necessary to address Toronto's housing crisis.
source_quote: These are the kinds of thoughtful policy changes that are necessary to address the housing crisis in Toronto.

summary: States that small business recovery must remain a priority alongside back-to-school focus.
source_quote: While we're rightly focused on back to school today, we can't lose sight of the small business recovery.

summary: Observes that Ontario's commercial eviction moratorium expired last month and rent relief is being extended piecemeal after rent was due.
source_quote: Ontario's commercial eviction moratorium expired last month and the rent relief program is being extended piecemeal again, over a week after rent is due.

summary: Calls for a decisive main street recovery plan involving federal, provincial, and municipal governments doubling down on early pandemic commitments.
source_quote: Our main streets need a decisive plan for recovery. It's going to take Feds... and Prov... working with the City... doubling down on the important commitments that were made early on during the pandemic.

event_label: The Beach #PickMeUp
source_quote: Coming up on September 20th! Join myself and @thetiffanypratt for The Beach #PickMeUp! Spend some time with the community, help to beautify our public spaces

summary: States the Danforth active transportation project is a strong start but more work remains.
source_quote: This project is a fantastic start, but more work remains to be done.

summary: Highlights work being done to support small businesses on the Danforth.
source_quote: speak with neighbours about the work being done to support small businesses and expand our active transportation network

event_label: Destination Danforth
source_quote: Mayor @JohnTory joined me on #DestinationDanforth to speak with neighbours about the work being done to support small businesses and expand our active transportation network.

summary: States that fears about urban interventions like these projects are largely unwarranted and the benefits are real, with residents asking for more.
source_quote: A lot of the fear-mongering that's associated with these sorts of projects isn't warranted, and the benefits are real. What I'm hearing, consistently, is people calling for more of these urban interventions.

quote_text: A lot of the fear-mongering that's associated with these sorts of projects isn't warranted, and the benefits are real. What I'm hearing, consistently, is people calling for more of these urban interventions.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States that the pandemic has highlighted the importance of a digital presence for local businesses.
source_quote: The pandemic has highlighted the importance of a digital presence for our local businesses.

summary: Supports the expansion of the Digital Main Street program to help Toronto small businesses adapt.
source_quote: This expansion of the Digital Main Street program will help many Toronto mom-and-pops future proof their businesses and adapt to these constantly changing times.

summary: States Destination Danforth aims to bring people back to the community and safely support local small businesses.
source_quote: #DestinationDanforth is about bringing folks back into the community and supporting our local mom-and-pops safely.

summary: Notes new changes on the Danforth including street patios, 24/7 parking, and a protected cycle track.
source_quote: Lots of new changes, with street patios, 24/7 parking, and a protected cycle track.

summary: States that BIAs play an important role in communities and supporting local businesses, especially during the pandemic.
source_quote: BIA's play an incredibly important role in our communities and work tirelessly to support local businesses. This has never been more clear than during the pandemic.

summary: Supports The Beach Village BIA's expansion to help local mom-and-pop businesses recover.
source_quote: I wholeheartedly support The Beach Village BIA (@makewaves.to) in their expansion as they work to help our mom-and-pops recover.

summary: States that agile decision making is crucial during the pandemic.
source_quote: agile decision making is crucial during this pandemic
