summary: Brought a motion, passed by Council, to accelerate the expansion process for The Beach Village BIA.
source_quote: I’m thankful to my Council colleagues for passing my motion to accelerate this process

summary: States investments in transit are critical for the sustainability of the TTC after pandemic pressures and to Toronto's recovery.
source_quote: These investments are especially critical for transit and the sustainability of our system after the immense pressure it was under as a result of the pandemic. The #TTC will be critical to our recovery and this funding will help to keep Toronto moving.

summary: States the time for action on policing and structural anti-racism is now.
source_quote: The time for action on policing and structural anti-Racism is now.

summary: Supports Mayor Tory's 81 recommendations to the Toronto Police board as following through on Council's commitment to action on anti-Black racism.
source_quote: Mayor Tory is bringing 81 recommendations to the Toronto Police board next week, making sweeping changes to Toronto's policing. These changes follow through on Council's commitment to pragmatically progressive action on anti-Black racism.

summary: References nearly 40 recommendations on policing/anti-racism passed by Toronto City Council in June.
source_quote: Following the nearly 40 recommendations passed by City Council in June

summary: Announced an online public consultation survey, open until August 18, on planned improvements to Ivan Forrest Gardens.
source_quote: Improvements are coming to the Ivan Forrest Gardens and we want to hear your thoughts on what changes are needed! An online survey is available until Tuesday, August 18th, to collect your feedback.

summary: Provides update on Destination Danforth Phase 3 construction, noting lane markings for bike lanes are nearly complete.
source_quote: #DestinationDanforth construction update - lane markings for Phase 3 are nearly done! Work to remove existing marks and paint the markings for bike lanes will finish tonight.

event_label: Community accessibility meeting on Destination Danforth
source_quote: Met with community members and City staff this morning to learn more about how we can improve accessibility on #DestinationDanforth. Thanks to Hema Murdock for organizing the meeting and sharing her thoughts and feedback.

summary: States municipalities deliver critical services but have the fewest financial tools to pay for them, leaving them vulnerable to shocks.
source_quote: despite the extensive breadth and scope of services we're expected to deliver, we are the least equipped with the financial tools and mechanisms to pay for them. Years of successive downloading, shrugging off responsibility and putting it on the back of property taxes and user fees, means we are particularly vulnerable to these sort of shocks and stresses.

summary: States municipal government is closest to people and does the heavy lifting of delivering critical day-to-day services.
source_quote: This branch of government is closest to people and does the heavy lifting, delivering critical services that folks rely on in their day-to-day lives.

pledge_text: Will continue to push and advocate for a New Deal for Cities.
source_quote: I'll continue to push and advocate for a New Deal for Cities.
specifics: Advocacy for a 'New Deal for Cities' to address municipal financial tools/funding.

summary: States that maintaining a healthy Toronto economy is crucial to Canada's long-term economic health.
source_quote: Maintaining a healthy economy in Toronto is crucial to the long-term economic health of Canada.

summary: Welcomes recent funding announcements as an investment to minimize fallout from the COVID-19 pandemic.
source_quote: The recent funding announcements are a very welcome investment to ensuring minimal fallout from the #COVID19 pandemic.

pledge_text: Commits to working with government partners to reach solutions on COVID-19 economic funding.
source_quote: Looking forward to seeing more details on this funding and working with our government partners to reach solutions!

summary: States residents should continue distancing from those outside their social circle and wear masks when distancing isn't possible as Toronto enters Stage 3 reopening.
source_quote: Toronto will be entering Stage 3 at 12:01am on Friday, July 31st! We've done a great job at stopping the spread, but we can't ease off now. Remember to keep your distance from those not in your social circle, and wear a mask whenever distancing isn't possible!

summary: States that priority bus lanes will shorten commutes, increase service frequency, and save money, benefiting frontline workers who rely on TTC buses.
source_quote: Expediting priority bus lanes will shorten these commutes, result in more frequent service, and save money.

summary: Observes that not everyone can work from home and that TTC buses are a crucial component of frontline workers' commutes.
source_quote: Not everyone has the option to work from home. For those who are working on the frontlines, #TTC buses are a crucial component of their commute.

summary: Phase 2 of Destination Danforth construction nearing completion; lane markings to be done by next day, physical separation by Friday.
source_quote: Phase 2 of the #DestinationDanforth construction is nearly complete! All lane markings will be implemented by tomorrow, with the installation of physical separation expected to be completed by Friday.

summary: States the restaurant and hospitality sector has had a tough few months and encourages residents to support local Danforth businesses.
source_quote: It's been a tough few months for the restaurant and hospitality sector, now's your chance to show them some #DanforthLove and enjoy the beginning of #DestinationDanforth!

summary: Announces launch of expanded patio program on the Danforth ('Destination Danforth') starting Saturday, with more locations rolling out further east in coming weeks.
source_quote: Sneak peek: here's your patio menu on the brand new Danforth starting Saturday night! More locations are coming further east in the next couple of weeks.

summary: Announces Phase 1 of Destination Danforth construction completing and Phase 2 (Jones to Woodbine) beginning, running 24/7 for roughly one week.
source_quote: Phase 1 of #DestinationDanforth construction will complete this afternoon, and Phase 2 (Jones to Woodbine) begins tonight! The construction will take roughly one week working 24/7.

summary: Supports Destination Danforth changes including expanded patio space, 24/7 parking, art installations, and a protected bike lane.
source_quote: We'll have more space for patios, more parking available 24/7, art installations, and a protected bike lane.

summary: Supports a protected bike lane on the Danforth as part of Destination Danforth.
source_quote: more parking available 24/7, art installations, and a protected bike lane

summary: Supports the Destination Danforth project with painted buffers and forthcoming physical separation for cycling infrastructure.
source_quote: First steps are being taken towards #DestinationDanforth! Painted buffers with different colours for our local BIAs, with physical separation coming soon. This has been a long time coming - can't wait to see it completed.

summary: Painted buffers installed on the Danforth as first steps of Destination Danforth, with physical separation to follow.
source_quote: First steps are being taken towards #DestinationDanforth! Painted buffers with different colours for our local BIAs, with physical separation coming soon.

summary: States that neighbourhood-specific housing plans will be more successful than a one-size-fits-all solution for Toronto's housing needs.
source_quote: There are hundreds of neighbourhoods in Toronto. Each of these neighbourhoods have different needs for housing. A plan specific to each area will be much more successful than a "one-size-fits-all" solution.

summary: States that tough conversations and hard work are needed to address housing inequality in Toronto.
source_quote: Tough conversations and hard work are needed to address housing inequality in Toronto.

summary: States that resident feedback as local experts is crucial to housing planning.
source_quote: This feedback as local experts is crucial.

summary: Consulted residents about the Missing Middle pilot coming to Beaches-East York; their input fed into the study and influenced the pilot's design.
source_quote: Earlier this year, I talked to residents about the Missing Middle pilot coming to #BEY later this year. Their input directly fed into the study and influenced the design of the pilot.

summary: States that wearing masks in enclosed public spaces is one of the most important things people can do to keep their community safe and stop the spread.
source_quote: Remember that masks are now required in enclosed public spaces! It's one of the most important things you can do to keep your community safe and stop the spread.

summary: Handed out masks to TTC riders at Woodbine station as part of a 1 million mask distribution initiative.
source_quote: Great morning at Woodbine station handing out masks for #TTC riders. 1 million masks will be handed out to keep Torontonians safe and support transit equity.

event_label: Mask handout for TTC riders
topic_focus: transit safety and mask distribution during COVID-19
source_quote: Great morning at Woodbine station handing out masks for #TTC riders.

summary: States that distributing masks to TTC riders supports rider safety and transit equity.
source_quote: 1 million masks will be handed out to keep Torontonians safe and support transit equity.

summary: States that surface transit is vital and priority routes are needed to connect historically underserved communities.
source_quote: Our surface transit is vital and these priority routes are needed to connect communities that have been historically underserved.

summary: Expediting the TTC bus priority route on Eglinton, with implementation planned for Fall.
source_quote: We're expediting the #TTC bus priority route on Eglinton, with implementation planned for Fall.

summary: States that wearing a face covering is one of the most important steps to stop the spread of COVID-19.
source_quote: Wearing a face covering is one of the most important steps you can take to stop the spread of #COVID19.

summary: Notes that a new by-law requiring masks in enclosed spaces takes effect today, with requirements for individuals and businesses.
source_quote: Masks are now required in enclosed spaces, starting today.

summary: States he will support both the Mayor's motions on anti-Black racism and police reform, and the motions for systemic change in policing put forward by Councillor Matlow and others.
source_quote: I'll be supporting both sets of motions on anti-Black racism and the police budget: the concrete steps to bring long overdue reform put forward by the Mayor, and the motions in solidarity for systemic change in policing put forward by Councillors Matlow and several others.

summary: Announced intent to vote in support of motions on anti-Black racism and police budget reform at City Council.
source_quote: As we come to the end of this debate, I'll be supporting both sets of motions on anti-Black racism and the police budget

summary: States that infrastructure investments on the Danforth are important to restoring consumer confidence as the economy reopens.
source_quote: These investments in our infrastructure are important to restoring consumer confidence as our economy continues to reopen.

summary: States that conduct at Woodbine Beach over the prior two weekends — including disregard for physical distancing and littering — was unacceptable.
source_quote: The situation we've seen at the Beach over the last two weekends is completely unacceptable. The level of disregard we saw, not only for physical distancing but even the basics of picking up after yourself, was shocking.

summary: Held conversations with City staff about response measures at Woodbine Beach and shared an update on steps being taken.
source_quote: I've had many conversations with City staff over the past weeks and wanted to share an update on the steps we're taking.

summary: States that anti-Black racism and defunding the police are serious issues requiring serious thinking and work to address.

pledge_text: Will keep constituents updated as more is learned about what is coming to Council on anti-Black racism and police defunding.
source_quote: I'll keep you updated as we learn more about what's coming to Council.

summary: Supports the Destination Danforth plan featuring expanded sidewalks and patios, street art, 24/7 parking on both sides, and a protected bike lane.
source_quote: Expanded sidewalks and patios, street art, 24/7 parking on both sides, a protected bike lane, and much more!

event_label: Community meeting on Destination Danforth with @decadiaries
source_quote: Join my community meeting with @decadiaries on Monday to learn more and share your thoughts.

summary: States that yoga and dance studios can safely accommodate physical distancing and should be included in Stage 2 of reopening.
source_quote: Yoga/dance studios are large, open spaces that could safely accommodate physical distancing and should be included in Stage 2 of reopening.

summary: Asked Premier Doug Ford and Minister Prabmeet Sarkaria to review guidelines on indoor recreation and make them more consistent.
source_quote: I'm asking Premier @fordnationdougford and Minister @prabsarkaria to review the guidelines on indoor recreation and make them more consistent.

summary: References upcoming changes to the Danforth including expanded patio space, enhanced streetscape, and active transportation infrastructure.
source_quote: the changes coming to the Danforth next month! Expanded patio space, enhanced streetscape, active transportation infrastructure, and more.

event_label: Community info session on Danforth changes with @decadiaries
source_quote: Join me and @decadiaries on June 22nd to learn more about the changes coming to the Danforth next month!

summary: States that well-planned density is needed to fund affordable housing and support diverse, vibrant neighborhoods in Toronto.
source_quote: We need well-planned density to pay for affordable housing and support the kind of diverse, vibrant neighborhoods we love in Toronto.

event_label: Planning and Housing Committee
source_quote: This is what we talked about at Planning and Housing Committee today.

summary: Supports Destination Danforth initiative including expanded patios, street beautification, and main street recovery measures.
source_quote: The City's bringing expanded patios to help restaurants reopen, investments to make the street more beautiful, road safety improvements with more sidewalk space and new bike lanes under #activeto to bring more visitors, and increased parking hours on both sides of the street (24/7). All to support local business and the main street recovery.

summary: Supports new bike lanes and expanded sidewalk space on the Danforth under ActiveTO.
source_quote: road safety improvements with more sidewalk space and new bike lanes under #activeto to bring more visitors

event_label: Destination Danforth business walk
topic_focus: small business main street recovery during COVID-19
source_quote: Thanks Mayor @johntory MP @julie_dabrusin and Councillor @paulafletcher for taking the time to talk to local business owners and community members about how to make this a success for everyone.

summary: States that more work remains to be done on the ActiveTO program and making streets safer.
source_quote: Spent the afternoon speaking w neighbours about the #ActiveTO program and how we can make our streets safer. Still have more work to do

summary: Held outdoor meetings with neighbours in the Beaches–East York area to discuss the ActiveTO program and street safety.
source_quote: Outdoor meetings in 'the family belt.' Spent the afternoon speaking w neighbours about the #ActiveTO program and how we can make our streets safer.

summary: States mandatory masks on the TTC are important for restoring ridership.
source_quote: The #TTC will likely make masks mandatory at its board meeting next week. That's important for restoring ridership.

summary: States bus priority corridors are needed to make service safer, more equitable, and more reliable for transit-dependent communities.
source_quote: We need this to make service safer, more equitable, and more reliable for our transit-dependent communities.

summary: Asking the TTC Board to fast-track rolling out bus priority corridors in time for September.
source_quote: At the meeting next week, I'm also asking the TTC Board to fast-track rolling out bus priority corridors in time for September.

summary: States that Bike Share expansion, planned pre-COVID, is even more critical now for Toronto's recovery.
source_quote: Planned pre-#COVID19, even more critical now for our recovery.

summary: Supports Bike Share Toronto's expansion: 1,850 new bikes, 300 e-bike pilot, reaching 20 wards including North York and Scarborough.
source_quote: Toronto's @bikeshareto just doubled its coverage! 1,850 new bikes, a 300 e-bike pilot project, and reaching 20 wards. With first-time expansion to North York and Scarborough, the last mile just got a little shorter.

summary: States that after months of work and thousands of calls, Ontario is putting a moratorium on commercial evictions to help small businesses access relief programs.
source_quote: After thousands of calls and months of work, we did it! Ontario is putting a moratorium on commercial evictions. Important news for small businesses giving everyone time to take advantage of relief programs.

summary: Supports Ontario's moratorium on commercial evictions as important for small businesses.
source_quote: Ontario is putting a moratorium on commercial evictions. Important news for small businesses giving everyone time to take advantage of relief programs.

summary: States that #CurbTO, #CafeTO, and #ActiveTO programs are being used to make the Danforth safer and more welcoming with space for pedestrians, cyclists, patios, and parking.
source_quote: Using #CurbTO #CafeTO & #ActiveTO we're making the Danforth safer and more welcoming for everyone: space for pedestrians,cyclists, patios, and parking.

summary: Hosted Mayor John Tory to speak with East End businesses and hear feedback on Destination Danforth.
source_quote: Thanks Mayor @johntory for speaking with our East End businesses and hearing feedback on #DestinationDanforth.

event_label: Destination Danforth business consultation with Mayor John Tory
topic_focus: Supporting East End businesses through CurbTO, CafeTO, and ActiveTO
source_quote: Thanks Mayor @johntory for speaking with our East End businesses and hearing feedback on #DestinationDanforth.

summary: States the federal CECRA rent relief program is not working for small businesses, with only ~4% of qualifying businesses applying, risking evictions on main streets.
source_quote: Estimates suggest 400,000 businesses should qualify but with barely 4% of qualifying businesses applying so far, the program isn't working for our small businesses. Simply put - those numbers add up to evictions on our main streets.

summary: States the Danforth project is about incentivizing people to return to main streets safely, not just cycling infrastructure.
source_quote: While this was an important step for cycling infrastructure, it's about much more than that. It's about incentivizing people to get back out on our main streets, safely.

summary: Supports giving pedestrians more space to physically distance while walking on Danforth.
source_quote: It's about giving pedestrians the space they need to physically distance themselves from others while enjoying a walk with their family.

summary: Supports providing local businesses with options for more patio space or expanded parking on Danforth.
source_quote: It's about providing options to local businesses for more patio space or expanded parking.

summary: States the Destination Danforth project aims to turn Danforth into a city-wide destination.
source_quote: This project is about turning Danforth into the destination we all know it can be. This is a landmark moment in the East End. #DestinationDanforth will attract folks from all over the City to see what we have to offer.

summary: References the Destination Danforth project as a landmark step for cycling infrastructure on Danforth Ave.
source_quote: While this was an important step for cycling infrastructure... This is a landmark moment in the East End.

summary: States that City Council's approval of expedited bike lanes is a landmark decision and the kind of quick decision-making residents expect during a pandemic.
source_quote: City Council has approved the plan for expediting bike lanes across the City. This is a landmark decision. This is the type of creative and quick decision making that our residents expect to see during a pandemic.

summary: Expresses support for upcoming bike lane changes on Danforth Avenue.
source_quote: Excited to see the big changes coming to #DestinationDanforth!

summary: City Council approved a plan to expedite bike lanes across the City.
source_quote: City Council has approved the plan for expediting bike lanes across the City.

summary: States that Destination Danforth aims to create an attractive, safe space for people to enjoy main streets and support a healthy recovery.
source_quote: #DestinationDanforth is about creating an attractive, safe space for folks to enjoy our main streets. This is about creating a healthy recovery, supporting our long-term physical/mental health, and sustainability of our environment.

summary: Supports active transportation initiatives on Danforth Ave (ActiveTO, BikeTO, WalkTO).
source_quote: #ActiveTO #BikeTO #WalkTO

summary: Supports Housing Now Phase 2 program to build affordable housing on city-owned sites on a fast-track timeline.
source_quote: we're welcoming two Housing Now Phase 2 sites to our neighbourhood. These are city-owned properties where we'll partner to build around 150 affordable homes for families in our community, on a fast-track timeline.

summary: Announces two Housing Now Phase 2 sites in the East End: Danforth Garage/Coxwell Barns redevelopment and the Harvey's site at 1631 Queen Street East, totaling ~150 affordable units.
source_quote: The two sites include: part of the proposed Danforth Garage/Coxwell Barns redevelopment at Coxwell and Danforth, and the Harvey's site at 1631 Queen Street East. In total, we're anticipating around 150 affordable new units across these sites.

summary: Supports the City's plan to fast-track 40km of cycling infrastructure including a protected bike lane on the Danforth.
source_quote: Mayor @JohnTory just announced the City's plan to fast-track implementing 40km of cycling infrastructure across Toronto, including the Danforth!

summary: States that economic recovery from the pandemic depends on revitalizing main streets like the Danforth.
source_quote: The road to economic recovery goes through our main streets. Over the course of the pandemic I've talked to hundreds of businesses and we know that bringing people back to places like the Danforth will be critical.

summary: Supports a $4 million pilot investment on the Danforth for public realm enhancements, patios, dedicated parking, and walking/cycling infrastructure.
source_quote: The pilot would see an unprecedented $4 million investment to enhance our public realm, create new opportunities for patios, provide dedicated parking, and add the infrastructure we need so that people can walk, ride and roll through our neighbourhood.

summary: States he has spoken to hundreds of businesses over the course of the pandemic.
source_quote: Over the course of the pandemic I've talked to hundreds of businesses and we know that bringing people back to places like the Danforth will be critical.

quote_text: This is about making Danforth your destination, for now and into the future.
speaker: Brad Bradford

quote_text: This is the transformative change that Toronto needs. Believe in the East End, and I'll see you on Danforth!
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States active transportation will be crucial to economic recovery, restoring consumer confidence, returning people to main streets, and easing pressure on transit.
source_quote: Active transportation will be crucial to restoring consumer confidence, getting people back to our main streets, and taking pressure off transit.

summary: States economic recovery requires thinking differently and positions Danforth as a destination for main-street activity.
source_quote: Our economic recovery will require us to think differently... It's time to make Danforth your destination.

summary: States that economic recovery runs through 'Main Street' and that residents should get out and support local businesses on the Danforth.
source_quote: The road to recovery runs through ‘Main Street’. We need to provide space for people while getting out and supporting local businesses.

summary: States the need for safe, active transportation on the Danforth.
source_quote: We need safe, active transportation.

summary: Announces release of a report on Danforth recovery and active transportation ('Destination Danforth') at 9:30 am.
source_quote: It’s time to make Danforth your destination. Report drops at 9:30 am.

summary: States ActiveTO on Lake Shore is a good way for people to get fresh air while physically distancing.
source_quote: It's an awesome way for people to get out and enjoy the fresh air while safely distancing themselves.

pledge_text: Teases a forthcoming announcement on additional bike infrastructure.
source_quote: Stay tuned for a big announcement on more bike infrastructure!

event_label: ActiveTO site visit on Lake Shore
source_quote: Great afternoon with Mayor @johntory checking out the #ActiveTO site on Lake Shore.

summary: States that the ActiveTO program has created quiet streets in Beaches-East York and announces a Lake Shore Blvd East closure between Coxwell and Kew Beach Avenue for the weekend.
source_quote: The #ActiveTO program has created a number of quiet streets in Beaches-East York. Lake Shore Blvd East will also be closed between Coxwell and Kew Beach Avenue this weekend.

summary: Supports the ActiveTO program's expansion to the Beaches, closing Lake Shore East to give space to pedestrians and cyclists.
source_quote: The #ActiveTO program is expanding to the Beaches this weekend! On Saturday and Sunday, Lake Shore East will be closed from Coxwell to Kew Beach Avenue to give some space to pedestrians and cyclists.

summary: Announces ActiveTO expansion to the Beaches with Lake Shore East closed from Coxwell to Kew Beach Avenue on Saturday and Sunday.
source_quote: The #ActiveTO program is expanding to the Beaches this weekend! On Saturday and Sunday, Lake Shore East will be closed from Coxwell to Kew Beach Avenue to give some space to pedestrians and cyclists.

summary: States that more than 850 park amenities including skate parks, basketball courts, and picnic shelters are being re-opened across the City.
source_quote: More than 850 park amenities are being re-opened across the City, including skate parks, basketball courts, and picnic shelters.

summary: Notes that no team sports are permitted and physical distancing will still be enforced at re-opened amenities.
source_quote: No team sports are permitted and physical distancing will still be enforced. Please enjoy the nice weather safely!

summary: States residents should continue physical distancing and wear masks as Ontario's Phase 1 reopening begins, framing it as a shared responsibility.
source_quote: With Phase 1 of Ontario's re-opening beginning tomorrow, please remember to continue #PhysicalDistancing and wear a mask! We all have a responsibility to protect each other from this virus.

summary: States that Toronto's approach to mobility needs to change to prioritize space for people and physical distancing as part of economic recovery.
source_quote: The way we are moving is changing, and our approach to mobility needs to change, too. This is #ActiveTO - prioritizing space for people & physical distancing. This will be a critical component of our economic recovery as we move towards reopening and consumer confidence returns.

event_label: ActiveTO on Lakeshore Blvd. West
topic_focus: transit / active transportation during COVID-19 recovery
source_quote: This is #ActiveTO - prioritizing space for people & physical distancing.

summary: States that improving home energy efficiency is one of the biggest individual actions to help protect the climate.
source_quote: Improving the energy efficiency of your home is one of the biggest things you can do to help protect our climate.

summary: States the cancellation of camps and major event permits is the right decision based on medical advice during COVID-19.
source_quote: It's hard news going into the long weekend but the right decision based on the medical advice.

summary: Acknowledges part-time workers will be impacted by camp cancellations and notes a plan is in place to support organizers of major events.
source_quote: Part-time workers are also going to be impacted. There is also a plan in place to support the organiziners for these major events.

summary: City announced cancellation of summer camps and event permits over 250 people until July 31st, with refunds being issued to ~68,000 camp registrants.
source_quote: Refunds are being issued for the 68,000 or so people signed up for camp... permits for events hosting over 250 people being cancelled until July 31st.

summary: States that all options should remain on the table to support small businesses through the pandemic.
source_quote: All options are still on the table to support small businesses. That's the mindset we need to ensure that our mom-and-pops survive the pandemic.

summary: Held a conversation with Minister Prabmeet Sarkaria about supporting small businesses during the pandemic.
source_quote: Great conversation with Minister @prabsarkaria. All options are still on the table to support small businesses.

summary: States the City's partnership with Ritual is an important step for small business in Toronto and shows commitment to creative solutions for business owners.
source_quote: The City's partnership with Ritual is an important step for small business in Toronto. Not just because it will help businesses survive until they re-open. It shows the commitment from the City to finding creative solutions to help business owners.

summary: States that small business community feedback has directly shaped the City's strategy to address challenges they face.
source_quote: Your feedback has directly impacted our strategy to address the challenges you face.

pledge_text: Commits to continued work on supporting small businesses beyond the Ritual partnership.
source_quote: We aren't done, but this will make a big difference for small businesses.

summary: Participated in months of behind-the-scenes conversations leading to the City's partnership with Ritual to support small businesses.
source_quote: The conversations behind the scenes of this program have been ongoing for months.

summary: Supports implementing a moratorium on small business commercial evictions while COVID-19 relief programs are designed and rolled out.
source_quote: With the legislature coming back to extend emergency powers, now is the time to implement a moratorium on small business evictions. Let's press pause until we can get our programs designed and rolled out.

summary: States Ontario has invested billions in public health and economic protection in response to COVID-19, and a commercial eviction moratorium would help realize those investments.
source_quote: Ontario has taken incredible steps to address COVID-19, investing billions in public health and the protection of our economy. A moratorium on commercial evictions will allow us to realize the full potential of those investments.

summary: States that current small business relief programs are rolling out too slowly given the urgency of the pandemic.
source_quote: It's heartbreaking that programs are being rolled out in six weeks, because businesses don't have six weeks. How many are we going to lose between now and mid-May?

summary: Supports tenant-centred rent relief as a measure to save small businesses during the pandemic.
source_quote: Here are four ways we could save small businesses right now: 1) Tenant-centres rent relief

summary: Supports a moratorium on commercial evictions to help small businesses during the pandemic.
source_quote: 2) Moratorium on commercial evictions

summary: Supports tax policy reform as a measure to save small businesses.
source_quote: 3) Tax policy reform

summary: Supports a vacant storefront tax as a measure to save small businesses.
source_quote: 4) Vacant storefront tax

summary: States more support is needed to preserve local small businesses through the pandemic.
source_quote: More support is needed to ensure we have local favourites to return to after the pandemic.

summary: States that government programs need to better respond to needs of local businesses, property owners, and lenders.
source_quote: More work is needed to ensure the gov programs available respond to the needs of local business, property owners, and lenders.

summary: States the importance of ensuring local businesses survive until the economy reopens and consumer confidence returns.
source_quote: We need to ensure our local businesses are still here as the economy opens back up, and consumer confidence gradually returns.

summary: Participated in weekly call with TABIA including 70+ participants from BIAs across the City.
source_quote: Our weekly call with TABIA included 70+ participants with BIAs from across the City.

topic_focus: Support for local businesses and BIAs during COVID-19
source_quote: Our weekly call with TABIA included 70+ participants with BIAs from across the City.

summary: States that supporting local musicians and artists during the pandemic is important to sustain the community's creative spirit.
source_quote: Our community is home to incredible musicians and community festivals, we can't let the pandemic dampen our creative spirit.

summary: Launched the 'East Ender-tainment' live music series running every Thursday in May, featuring local musicians via Facebook Live.
source_quote: I've teamed-up with some of your local favourites for the East Ender-tainment live music series every Thursday in May.

event_label: East Ender-tainment live music series
source_quote: the East Ender-tainment live music series every Thursday in May... kicking us off are: ● Jen Schaffer & the Shiners ● May Akanuma ● TRAINWRECK
topic_focus: supporting local musicians during the pandemic

summary: States a moratorium on commercial evictions is crucial until provincial and federal relief funds begin flowing.
source_quote: A moratorium on commercial evictions is crucial until dollars start to flow from Provincial - Federal programs.

summary: Toronto City Council unanimously supported a moratorium on commercial evictions at its first virtual meeting on pandemic matters.
source_quote: It was great to see unanimous support from Mayor @johntory and my council colleagues.

summary: Participated in Toronto City Council's first virtual meeting to discuss urgent pandemic-related matters.
source_quote: Toronto City Council had our first virtual meeting yesterday to discuss urgent matters related to the pandemic.

summary: Participated in the City of Toronto's first online Council meeting.
source_quote: Back in the saddle. City of Toronto's first online Council meeting. Collaborative and productive, advancing important items to keep the city moving forward.

summary: States that small business evictions should be halted until federal-provincial rent assistance funds start flowing, to incentivize landlord participation in the program.
source_quote: We need to stop small business evictions until $$ start flowing with Fed-Prov rent assistance program. This incentivizes landlords to sign-up, making the program more impactful.

summary: Authored a letter to Premier Doug Ford ahead of Council calling for a halt to small business evictions until federal-provincial rent assistance funds flow.
source_quote: My letter to Premier @fordnationdougford ahead of Council tomorrow.

summary: Announces a 24-hour cycling fundraiser for frontline healthcare workers at Michael Garron Hospital, joined virtually by cyclists worldwide.
source_quote: On Friday, I'll be riding for 24 hours to raise funds for frontline healthcare workers @michaelgarronhospital.

event_label: #CRUSHCOVID 24-hour ride for Michael Garron Hospital
source_quote: I'll be joined virtually by cyclists around the world, coming together to #CRUSHCOVID.
topic_focus: fundraising for frontline healthcare workers during COVID-19

summary: States that as the first wave of small business evictions occurs, the city needs to double down on main streets as the backbone of communities.
source_quote: As we see the first wave of small business evictions, we need to double-down on main streets as the backbone of our communities.

summary: Notes the east end has significant experience with vacant storefronts, in the context of the Shore Leave closing.
source_quote: We've got too much experience with vacant storefronts in the east end.

summary: States that governments need to move fast on how to support small businesses and make cash available to them.
source_quote: We need to move fast on the "how" and make cash available.

summary: Observes that all levels of government understand the need to support small businesses and are willing to act.
source_quote: It's clear that all governments understand the need to support small businesses and are willing to act.

summary: Consulted with hundreds of small business owners, summarized their feedback, and brought it forward in a call with the Minister of Small Business and the Mayor.
source_quote: I've had communications with hundreds of business owners over the past weeks. I summarized their feedback this weekend and brought it forward in our call this morning

summary: Authored an op-ed summarizing small business owners' feedback (linked in bio).
source_quote: Op-Ed link in bio

event_label: Call with Minister of Small Business Mary Ng and Mayor John Tory
source_quote: I spoke with Minister of Small Businesses @mary_ng and Mayor @johntory earlier today.

summary: Coordinated donation of 2,000 hand sanitizers from Access Storage to support East End frontline workers during COVID-19.
source_quote: Very grateful to @AccessStorageca for their donation of 2,000 hand sanitizers to support our East End frontline workers.

summary: States his office is connecting offers of support from residents, organizations, and companies with people who need help during the crisis.
source_quote: My office has received an outpouring of support from residents, organizations, and companies looking to help in times of crisis. We’re here to connect those resources with the people who need them most.

summary: States that small business commercial tenants face asset seizure and lockouts without the protections renters have, and could be forced to close permanently without rent relief.
source_quote: Unlike renters, many commercial tenants will face the threat of asset seizure and lockouts in just a few days. No protection has been announced for these businesses like that in place for renters. Many of your favourite local shops and restaurants will be forced to close for good without immediate #smallbusinessrentrelief.

summary: States that no small business owner, tenant or landlord, should have to choose between keeping the lights on and feeding their families.
source_quote: No small business owner, be they a tenant or a landlord, should have to choose between keeping the lights on or feeding their families.

summary: Asked Premier Doug Ford for a freeze on commercial lockouts and a rent relief fund for small businesses.
source_quote: That's why we're asking Premier @fordnationdougford for a freeze on lockouts and a rent relief fund to #keepthelightson.

quote_text: No small business owner, be they a tenant or a landlord, should have to choose between keeping the lights on or feeding their families.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States that all eviction orders for small businesses should be stopped as a critical action amid the COVID-19 response.
source_quote: we're still waiting for one critical action: stopping all eviction orders for small businesses

summary: Observes that there has been an unprecedented response from all levels of government to support small businesses.
source_quote: There's been an unprecedented response from all levels of government to support small businesses this week.

summary: States medical workers should not have to worry about parking during COVID-19.
source_quote: None of our medical workers should be worried about parking during #COVID19.

summary: Worked with Councillor Paula Fletcher and the City to secure free parking for hospital staff at S. Walter Stewart Library, adjacent to Michael Garron Hospital.
source_quote: Councillor @paulafletcher and I have worked with the City to secure free parking for all hospital staff at S. Walter Stewart Library, adjacent to @michaelgarronhospital.

summary: Set up his website as a one-stop resource compiling COVID-19 programs offered by all levels of government.
source_quote: I've set up my website (link in bio) as a one-stop resource for programs offered by all levels of government.

summary: States residents have found it difficult to stay updated during COVID-19 because the situation can change hourly.
source_quote: I've heard consistently from residents during #COVID19 that it's difficult to stay updated when the situation can change hourly.

summary: States that businesses are the backbone of the city's economy and that the City supports them through COVID-19.
source_quote: These businesses are the backbone of our economy and we want them to know that we have their back.

specifics: Conference calls with businesses across Toronto, this week
source_quote: I'll be on conference calls with businesses across the City this week to hear their feedback on how we can support them through #COVID-19.

summary: States that the coming months will be difficult for local businesses and that the City should support them.
source_quote: These next few months will be a difficult time for local businesses. That's why I'm reaching out to get their feedback on how the City can support them through this.

summary: Launched a survey for local business owners to gather feedback on how the City can support them.
source_quote: I'm reaching out to get their feedback on how the City can support them through this. I encourage any business owners to fill out the survey - link in my bio.

summary: States that the coming weeks and months will be difficult for small businesses during COVID-19.
source_quote: These next few weeks and months will be tough for small businesses.

pledge_text: The new Economic Support and Recovery task force will work with small businesses to identify how to best provide aid.
specifics: Economic Support and Recovery task force engaging with small businesses to determine aid
source_quote: The new Economic Support and Recovery task force will work with these businesses to identify how we can best provide aid.

summary: References the formation of a new Economic Support and Recovery task force to support small businesses during COVID-19.
source_quote: The new Economic Support and Recovery task force will work with these businesses to identify how we can best provide aid.

summary: States local businesses are under serious pressure from COVID-19 and need support, including from landlords.
source_quote: Since #covid_19 began affecting daily life in Toronto, I've been hearing from business owners who are under serious pressure.

summary: Working with the Mayor to support local businesses through COVID-19 and urging landlords to join the effort; issued a letter.
source_quote: I'm working with the Mayor to support local business through this and urging landlords to join the effort. See the full letter above.

summary: States that a Missing Middle pilot is coming to the Danforth area to explore how different forms of housing can bolster the housing market.
source_quote: A pilot is coming to our area soon that will explore how different forms of housing can bolster the housing market.

summary: Held community outreach with City Planning staff on the Danforth, discussing housing supply, affordability, and the Missing Middle.
source_quote: Great day out in the community with my office and staff from City Planning. We were talking with residents about housing supply and affordability as well as the Missing Middle.

topic_focus: housing supply, affordability, and the Missing Middle
source_quote: Great day out in the community with my office and staff from City Planning. We were talking with residents about housing supply and affordability as well as the Missing Middle.

summary: States that 'missing middle' housing forms (duplexes to low-rise apartments) are limited in where they can be located in Toronto.
source_quote: The Missing Middle refers to housing forms that range from duplexes to low-rise apartments that are limited in where they can be located.

summary: Supports a pilot program in Beaches-East York exploring how new zoning by-laws could improve housing supply and create a more equitable city.
source_quote: A pilot program is coming to Beaches-East York soon that will investigate how new zoning by-laws could improve this housing supply in Toronto and create a more equitable city.

pledge_text: Will be door-knocking in the Danforth/Woodbine area to hear residents' thoughts on missing middle housing.

source_quote: Thanks to @mondelez_international for stopping by the office with some delicious snacks today. Their expanded location in East York created 100 jobs in the area

source_quote: My motion aims to move us away from ad hoc decision-making and create a consistent, thoughtful approach that aligns with our City priorities.

summary: States a systematic approach is needed to address fairness and equity through TTC fares.
source_quote: We need a systematic approach if we’re going to address issues like fairness and equity through our TTC fares.

summary: Worked with 55 Division to bring four Neighbourhood Community Officers to the O'Connor-Parkview area.
source_quote: Four Neighbourhood Community Officers will work with residents to learn more about the challenges you face and will leverage @torontopolice resources to find solutions... Huge thanks to Superintendent Stroble and 55 Division for working with me to get this in place.

event_label: Welcome event for Neighbourhood Community Officers
source_quote: Please join me on Monday, February 24th, at the O'Connor Community Centre to give them a warm #BEY welcome!

event_label: Kingston Road walk-around with local business owners
source_quote: Thanks to Katya from the @greatescapebookstore for the walk-around on #KingstonRoad last week. It was a fantastic opportunity to meet local business owners and hear their input on how we can be making our Main Streets vibrant again. Shoutout to @blackdogcafeto, @skautdesigntoronto, and Beech Dental for the warm welcome!

summary: Canvassed door-to-door in Parkview Hills to gather neighbour feedback on 2020 budget priorities.
source_quote: Great afternoon hitting the doors in Parkview Hills and talking to neighbours about their priorities for the 2020 budget.

event_label: Door-knocking in Parkview Hills on 2020 budget priorities

source_quote: I wanna thank our police officers, our special constables, our firefighters, our paramedics, our nurses... You are the first responders. You're our first line in advance.

pledge_text: As Mayor, will always have the back of those who wear the uniform of service to the city.
source_quote: To the men and women who proudly wear the uniform of service to our city: count on me to always have your back as Mayor.

pledge_text: If elected mayor, will give first responders full support and advocate for improvements in the courts.
source_quote: if I'm elected as your mayor, you will have my full support. I will advocate for improvement in our courts and make sure that you have the tools and the resources to get your job done
specifics: Advocate for court improvements; ensure first responders have tools and resources.

event_label: Gloves Up Toronto — Police Appreciation Week event
topic_focus: Thanking first responders during Police Appreciation Week
source_quote: As Police Appreciation Week comes to a close, it was an honour to join everyone at @glovesuptoronto to thank the first responders who keep our communities safe every day.

summary: States that Mayor Chow's speeches on housing have not been matched by action, and housing starts fell to a 30-year low under her watch.
source_quote: If Mayor Chow had matched her speeches on housing with action, folks in Toronto might not be struggling to find a place to call home. But under her watch, housing starts last year fell to a 30-year low.

summary: States that development charges have increased 1200% over the past fifteen years, discouraging building permits and project starts.
source_quote: Development charges have increased 1200% over the past fifteen years. If you had rocketed your prices like that, you'd be out of business. People aren't pulling building permits.

summary: States Torontonians should not accept the current pace of housing construction as a way of life.
source_quote: Torontonians do not need to accept this as a way of life. You can demand better.

pledge_text: As Mayor, will focus on getting to yes on building homes that are affordable for families and the next generation.
specifics: Focus on approvals for affordable housing construction.
source_quote: As Mayor, I'll focus on this: getting to yes on building homes that you, your family, and the next generation can actually afford.

pledge_text: Will approach housing with a 'get to yes' mentality, work faster, and remove roadblocks to building.
source_quote: My mentality will be how do we get to yes and how do we do it faster? How do we roll up our sleeves and solve problems? When roadblocks are put in front of us, how do we work together to remove them?

quote_text: My mentality will be how do we get to yes and how do we do it faster?
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States Toronto functions because residents actively help each other, and that City Hall should operate with the same effort.
source_quote: Toronto works because people show up every day and make it work. City Hall should too.

summary: States Toronto has a unique sense of community not found to the same degree in other cities or parts of Ontario.
source_quote: That's a nice sense of community that, you know, I don't think you get to the same degree in other cities or other parts of Ontario. It's a unique Toronto thing.

summary: States the city needs a campaign and mayor who bring Toronto back together, celebrate its successes, and address what isn't working.
source_quote: we need a campaign and a mayor who brings this city back together... celebrate that success, amplify the things that are working, and be very focused on trying to address the things that aren't.

quote_text: I want people to believe in Toronto again.
speaker: Brad Bradford

quote_text: Toronto works because people show up every day and make it work. City Hall should too.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States the Mayor's scheduling of major road closures during a weekend with major events was poor planning that caused gridlock.
source_quote: You shouldn't have been stuck in gridlock this weekend because of the Mayor's poor planning.

summary: States the coming weekend, with no major events, would have been a more thoughtful time to schedule the road closures.
source_quote: common sense would suggest this coming weekend where none of those events are taking place would have been a more thoughtful way of doing it.

summary: Supports 24/7 construction on major projects to shorten timelines.
source_quote: I've always been for twenty four seven construction. You know, I pushed for that for months with respect to the Gardner.

pledge_text: Will never schedule major road closures during weekends when major events are running in the city.
specifics: No major road closures scheduled concurrently with major city events.
source_quote: I promise you this. I will never be scheduling major road closures when we have major events running in the city.

summary: Advocated for months for 24/7 construction on the Gardiner Expressway project, ultimately shaving approximately a year and a half off the timeline.
source_quote: I pushed for that for months with respect to the Gardner. Took four months of advocacy, but we finally got the mayor there, and we were able to shave a year and a half off of that project.

quote_text: I will never be scheduling major road closures when we have major events running in the city.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States the DVP closure was poorly scheduled on a weekend with multiple major events (Blue Jays, TFC vs Inter Miami, Toronto Tempo kickoff, Sporting Life 10K, Mother's Day) and reflects poor planning.
source_quote: On a weekend with the Blue Jays homestead, the TFC playing intra Miami featuring Lionel Messi, the largest attended game ever at BMO Field, the inaugural kickoff game for the Toronto Tempo, the sporting life 10 k, and, of course, Mother's Day... This is not planning. This is congestion by choice

summary: States the city should coordinate major road closures with the event calendar and plan in advance to minimize disruption for drivers.
source_quote: A city we can be proud of doesn't stack major closures on top of major events. It coordinates and pays attention. Toronto taxpayers deserve both.

summary: Criticizes Mayor Chow's framing of the DVP closure as a 'stress test,' stating Torontonians are already stressed by congestion.
source_quote: Mayor Chow calls this weekend's DVP closure a "stress test." Well, Madame Mayor — Torontonians are officially stressed while they're stuck in your congestion by choice.

pledge_text: Frames the October election as a choice for a Mayor who respects residents' time and plans ahead.
source_quote: This October, it's time for a Mayor who respects your time and puts in the work to plan ahead.
specifics: Better coordination of road closures with the city's event calendar.

quote_text: This is not planning. This is congestion by choice, and it's because folks in the mayor's office don't care enough or value your time to do it right.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States that Mayor Chow has asked Torontonians to lower expectations and accept decline in the city.
source_quote: For the past three years, Mayor Chow has asked Toronto to lower its expectations and accept decline.

summary: States that crime, congestion, and costs are the defining daily experiences of life in Toronto in 2026.
source_quote: There are three things that Torontonians feel and experience every day. Crime, congestion, and costs. Those three things are the texture of life in Toronto in 2026.

summary: States he does not accept potholes, encampments, open air drug use on the TTC, gridlock, and vacant storefronts as normal for Toronto.
source_quote: Accept the potholes. Accept the encampments. Accept the open air drug use on the TTC. Accept the gridlock that keeps you away from your family. Accept the vacant storefronts... I do not accept these things

summary: States that announcements from the city do not turn into real projects under the current mayor.
source_quote: Accept the announcement that never turns into a real project.

pledge_text: Pledges to fix the broken deal between the city and Torontonians.
source_quote: Mayor Chao has broken that deal, and we're gonna fix it.

pledge_text: Invites supporters to join his campaign to build a city Torontonians can be proud of.
source_quote: Join me and let's build a city we can be proud of.

quote_text: Crime, congestion, and costs. Those three things are the texture of life in Toronto in 2026.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States that candidates must maintain clear separation between campaign resources and their elected office, and that using office resources for campaign activity crosses into a gray area.
source_quote: You have to have a very clear separation of campaign resources from your office. And right now, when you go out, of course, and use the resources of your office, use your campaign colors on city signs, go into ridings for photo ops rather than announcements, I think that's where you start to get into that gray area.

summary: States that Olivia Chow should be honest about her intentions to run for re-election and stop using taxpayer resources to campaign.
source_quote: Olivia Chow owes Torontonians that same respect. She should be honest about her intentions to run and stop using taxpayer resources to campaign.

summary: Registered as a candidate for Mayor of Toronto on the first day of the campaign (May 1).
source_quote: I'm running for Mayor of Toronto. I registered on the first day of this campaign.

quote_text: All I'm asking is for the mayor to be honest and transparent with Torontonians, make her intentions known.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States that Etobicoke has felt out of the discussion at City Hall and needs attention across the area from Lakeshore to Steeles.
source_quote: Etobicoke has felt very much out of the discussion down at city hall, and I know Brad will be attentive to the needs of, the constituency, from the Lakeshore all the way up to Steele's.

pledge_text: Pledges to work hard for residents in the west end of the city (Etobicoke).
source_quote: we're gonna work hard for the folks out here in the West end of the city

party_role: Former Toronto District School Board Trustee and former City Councillor
context: mayoral campaign; support in Etobicoke
source_quote: I'm out today to support, councilor Brad Bradford and his run for mayor because quite frankly, I think Brad understands Etobicoke.

quote_text: Etobicoke has felt very much out of the discussion down at city hall, and I know Brad will be attentive to the needs of the constituency, from the Lakeshore all the way up to Steele's.
speaker: John Campbell

summary: Officially launched campaign for Mayor of Toronto.
source_quote: The campaign has launched. I am officially running for mayor of Toronto

pledge_text: Pledges to fight for Torontonians and build a city residents can be proud of.
source_quote: I'm here to fight for the Torontonians who show up every day and expect city hall to do the same.

summary: States Toronto does not have to settle for the current state of the city.
source_quote: For those who know we don't have to keep settling for the way things are.

quote_text: I am officially running for mayor of Toronto, and together, we can build a city that we can be proud of.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States that Toronto no longer has balanced budgets and that spending is out of control.
source_quote: We no longer have balanced budgets. We have spending out of control.

summary: States that Toronto is no longer clean and safe.
source_quote: Our city is no longer clean and safe

pledge_text: Pledges to bring spending under control.
source_quote: He's gonna bring spending under control.

pledge_text: Pledges to bring back a safe and clean city.
source_quote: He's gonna bring back a safe and clean city.

pledge_text: Commits to delivering an affordable, safe city where residents are not stuck in gridlock.
source_quote: A safe Toronto that's affordable, and where you're not stuck in gridlock. That's what we're here to deliver.
specifics: affordability, safety, reducing gridlock

pledge_text: Commits to working to ensure an affordable, safe, and clean city for everybody.
source_quote: we're gonna do everything that we can to make sure that we have an affordable city and a safe city and a clean city for everybody.

party_role: Former Toronto City Councillor and former Deputy Mayor
context: mayoral campaign
source_quote: I am looking forward to Bad as the candidate for mayor. I share his values. He shares my values... I'm looking forward to his election as mayor.

quote_text: A safe Toronto that's affordable, and where you're not stuck in gridlock. That's what we're here to deliver.
speaker: Brad Bradford

summary: States Scarborough has been overlooked and deserves investment proportional to its size and importance within Toronto.
source_quote: Scarborough has been overlooked for far too long, and that's going to change when I'm Mayor of Toronto.

summary: Supports the Scarborough subway extension to Scarborough City Centre, noting current mayor Olivia Chow previously opposed the project.
source_quote: There's serious construction going on finally as as they build the, subway extension to the Scarborough City Center... the current mayor, you know, I friends with Olivia Chow. I've got nothing against Olivia, but she wasn't there when we needed her. She opposed that project.

summary: States Scarborough represents nearly a third of Toronto with nearly a million people and should receive investments correlating with its significance.
source_quote: Scarborough is in fact of nearly a full third of the city of Toronto, and there are nearly a million people out here... we just wanna make sure Scarborough gets its fair share that the investments correlate with the the significance of the importance and prominence of Scarborough.

pledge_text: Will show up to fight for families in all corners of Toronto every day, not only during election cycles.
source_quote: I'll show up to fight for families in all corners of our city every single day, not just during an election cycle.

pledge_text: Pledges to keep fighting for Scarborough and deliver the infrastructure residents deserve.
source_quote: I'm always gonna be here to follow in your footsteps fighting for Scarborough and make sure that we're building and delivering the infrastructure that folks here in Scarborough deserve.

party_role: Former Scarborough councillor, Metro councillor, and provincial minister
context: Mayoral campaign; Scarborough advocacy
source_quote: For decades, Brad Duguid has been fighting for the people of Scarborough. I'm honoured to have his support.

event_label: Endorsement appearance with Brad Duguid at Kennedy Station
topic_focus: Scarborough subway extension and Scarborough advocacy
source_quote: we're standing at Kennedy Station here. There's serious construction going on finally as as they build the, subway extension to the Scarborough City Center.

quote_text: We need somebody like you in the mayor's seat that gets us.
speaker: Brad Duguid

summary: States City Hall needs to do more to protect renters and restore affordability in Toronto.
source_quote: City Hall has to put in the work to protect renters and make our city affordable once again.

summary: States the city needs to be more proactive and assertive in enforcing against bad landlords to protect vulnerable tenants.
source_quote: when we have those types of violations, the city needs to be more proactive, more assertive getting in there faster so that we can we can keep people safe.

summary: Notes affordability concerns frequently translate to rent, given that over half of Toronto's population rents.
source_quote: when we talk about affordability so quickly, that translates to to rent. You know, there's a lot of people that that rent here in Toronto, over half our population.

summary: References City of Toronto investments in the RentSafeTO program and municipal bylaw enforcement against landlords not taking action.
source_quote: the city of Toronto has had to do some work on that also, you know, with the investments in the rent safe program, with making that, we have our municipal bylaw teams out there, driving enforcement when when landlords haven't taken action.

quote_text: If you want to live in Toronto, we want to have you.
speaker: Brad Bradford

source_quote: I'm looking forward to working with you further in your role as Parliamentary Secretary for Combatting Crime to create a safer Toronto for everyone who calls it home.
specifics: Collaboration with Vince Gasparro in his Parliamentary Secretary role

event_label: Morning visit in Eglinton-Lawrence
source_quote: Thanks @vgasparro1 for a great morning in Eglinton-Lawrence.

summary: Supported passage of bubble zone legislation at Toronto City Council to protect places of worship including synagogues and community centres.
source_quote: His unwavering commitment to protecting Jewish life and religious freedom led to the passing of crucial bubble zone legislation at Toronto City Council. These protections ensure that synagogues, community centres, and other places of worship, Jewish and beyond, we remain sanctuaries of safety and peace.

event_label: Shabbat dinner with a Jewish Toronto family
source_quote: Tonight, as we welcome Shabbat, my family is honoured to be joined by Councillor Brad Bradford and his family.

party_name: Host of Shabbat dinner (Jewish community member)
